AI.motivation: 许多组织为应对外部压力而采取性别平等举措，但这些努力往往停留在合规层面，未能真正改变日常规范、关系和系统。亟需一种能够持久且行为化地实现性别平等的组织模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值观视角下的性别平等（values-based perspective），结合组织文化、心理安全感、包容性系统和持续行为对齐等理论。
AI.method: 以柔道为组织类比的案例/模式分析，通过考察柔道在训练、领导、裁判、竞赛和发展路径中如何规范化包容性行为来构建理论。
AI.findings: 1）价值观通过日常实践、共同期望和结构设计制度化后才能真正发挥影响；2）柔道展示了深层嵌入的价值观架构如何长期维持性别平等；3）价值观驱动的机制比合规性政策更能产生持久、可信和行为化的平等效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出价值观视角下的性别平等理论框架，将组织文化、心理安全感、包容性系统和行为对齐联系起来，拓展了组织性别平等研究的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 柔道提供了一个具体可操作的模型，展示组织如何将宣称的价值观转化为日常机制，使性别平等更持久、可信且在行为层面真实可见。

title: CARS: A Cost-Aware Right-Sizing Framework for Spark Workloads on Azure Databricks
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: CARS: A Cost-Aware Right-Sizing Framework for Spark Workloads on Azure Databricks
detail.abstract: Cost optimization for Spark workloads on managed lakehouse platforms such as Azure Databricks remains under-served by existing literature, which addresses cluster sizing, autoscaling, and transient instance management as separate concerns. We present CARS (Cost-Aware Right-Sizing), a unified framework that formalizes the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for batch ETL workloads on Azure Databricks as a five-component decomposition incorporating Databricks Unit (DBU) pricing, Azure infrastructure costs, storage tiers, egress, and-distinctively-explicit penalty terms for autoscaling inefficiency, spot instance eviction risk, and resource idleness. We formulate cost-aware right-sizing as a constrained mixed-integer non-linear program and provide a tractable enumeration algorithm with a closed-form subroutine for spot-ratio optimization. Validation against published benchmarks (TPC-DS at 1 TB and 10 TB, HiBench, and a synthetic shuffle-heavy workload) using Azure pricing data shows CARS-selected configurations achieve 40-69% TCO reduction versus default-autoscaling configurations, 14-54% versus the Databricks-recommended spot pattern, and 15-33% versus an OptEx-style cost-optimal baseline that omits inefficiency penalties, while satisfying SLA runtime constraints. We release a reference implementation as open source. The framework generalizes to AWS Databricks via parameter substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARS（成本感知的合理规模选择）框架，通过五组件TCO分解和混合整数非线性规划，为Azure Databricks上的Spark批处理ETL工作负载实现40-69%的总拥有成本降低，并满足SLA约束。
AI.research_question: 如何为托管湖仓平台（如Azure Databricks）上的Spark工作负载实现统一的成本优化，同时满足SLA运行时约束？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将集群规模调整、自动缩放和临时实例管理作为独立问题处理，缺乏对Azure Databricks这类托管湖仓平台Spark工作负载的统一成本优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 总拥有成本(TCO)五组件分解模型（DBU定价、Azure基础设施成本、存储层、出站流量、效率惩罚项）；约束混合整数非线性规划。
AI.method: 提出CARS框架，形式化TCO为五组件分解，构建约束混合整数非线性规划，设计可处理的枚举算法与现货比例优化的闭式子程序。使用TPC-DS（1TB和10TB）、HiBench及合成shuffle密集型基准测试验证。
AI.findings: CARS选择的配置相比默认自动缩放配置减少40-69% TCO，相比Databricks推荐的现货模式减少14-54%，相比省略效率惩罚项的OptEx风格成本最优基线减少15-33%，同时满足SLA运行时约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将自动缩放低效、现货实例驱逐风险和资源闲置的显式惩罚项纳入TCO分解框架；将成本感知合理规模选择形式化为统一的约束混合整数非线性规划问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供开源参考实现；框架可通过参数替换泛化到AWS Databricks；在实际Azure定价数据和多种标准基准测试上验证了显著的TCO降低效果。

title: Pricing Inefficiencies in the Independent Beat Market: Does Branding Quality Predict Pricing Power Among Independent Music Producers?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pricing Inefficiencies in the Independent Beat Market: Does Branding Quality Predict Pricing Power Among Independent Music Producers?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships or organizational affiliations that could have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved no human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. All data were collected through structured observation of publicly accessible beat marketplace listings. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded as an independent research project.

detail.abstract: The independent digital beat marketplace, in which music producers license instrumental tracks directly to recording artists via platforms such as BeatStars and Traktrain, represents a rapidly growing segment of the creator economy that has received virtually no empirical attention. This study investigates whether observable business signals, principally branding quality and licensing transparency, predict lease pricing power among independent producers. Drawing on an original structured-observation dataset of 112 beat listings collected from BeatStars and Traktrain in 2026, this study finds substantial evidence of pricing inefficiency rooted in information asymmetry and widespread underdevelopment of producer business infrastructure. Producers scoring 3 or above on a 5-point branding scale charge an average of $35.20 per lease compared to $20.86 for low-branding producers, representing a 68.8% differential. Producers with clear licensing terms posted charge $33.17 versus $19.67 for those without, constituting a 68.6% premium. A cumulative business-signal index reveals a near-monotonic doseresponse relationship: producers with three or more observable business signals average $34.35 per lease versus $20.73 for those with zero, a difference of 65.8%. These findings are interpreted through the frameworks of signaling theory (Spence, 1973), experience goods (Nelson, 1970), and adverse selection (Akerlof, 1970), and suggest that targeted business literacy interventions could substantially improve market efficiency and Settipalli (2026) 1 PRICING INEFFICIENCIES IN THE INDEPENDENT BEAT MARKET Settipalli (2026) producer revenue outcomes. Limitations, directions for future research, and practical recommendations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于BeatStars和Traktrain平台112条节拍列表的结构化观测数据，发现独立数字节拍市场中存在显著定价低效问题。高品牌质量（评分≥3）的制片人租赁均价$35.20，较低品牌组（$20.86）高出68.8%；明确许可条款的制片人收费$33.17，较不明确者（$19.67）溢价68.6%；拥有三项及以上商业信号的制片人均价$34.35，较无信号者（$20.73）高出65.8%。研究借助信号理论、经验品理论和逆向选择理论解释上述发现。
AI.research_question: 可观察的商业信号（品牌质量、许可透明度）是否能预测独立音乐制片人在数字节拍市场中的租赁定价能力？
AI.motivation: 独立数字节拍市场（如BeatStars、Traktrain）是创作者经济中快速增长的细分领域，但几乎未有实证研究关注；市场存在信息不对称和制片人商业基础设施普遍欠发达的现象，可能造成定价效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Spence, 1973）；经验品理论（Nelson, 1970）；逆向选择理论（Akerlof, 1970）。
AI.method: 结构化观测数据法，收集2026年BeatStars和Traktrain平台上112条节拍列表，构建品牌质量5分量表、许可透明度等商业信号指标，并进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 高品牌质量制片人溢价68.8%（$35.20 vs. $20.86）；明确许可条款者溢价68.6%（$33.17 vs. $19.67）；商业信号指数呈近似单调剂量反应关系，三项及以上信号者溢价65.8%（$34.35 vs. $20.73）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号理论、经验品理论和逆向选择理论拓展至独立数字节拍市场这一新兴创作者经济领域，为理解信息不对称下的定价机制提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明针对制片人的商业素养干预（如品牌建设、许可透明化）可显著提升市场效率和制片人收入；为平台和从业者提供了可操作的价格优化方向。

title: Comprehensive analysis of food supply in Spain based on the TABULA™ branded food composition database
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comprehensive analysis of food supply in Spain based on the TABULA™ branded food composition database
detail.abstract: Improving the nutritional quality of food products is a key strategy for advancing public health and encouraging healthier dietary practices. This can be achieved through food reformulation, which involves modifying processing methods and product compositions to enhance beneficial nutrients while reducing components associated with negative health outcomes. To monitor these developments within the Spanish food market, TABULA™, an updated branded food composition database, was developed and systematically expanded. A comprehensive descriptive analysis was performed using the first release of the database, which contains information on more than 6,500 pre-packaged food and beverage products marketed in Spain between January 2022 and November 2023. Data were meticulously collected from product labels of both branded and private-label items available through major online retail platforms. Products were classified according to the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Office for Europe nutrient profiling model to facilitate nutritional assessment and comparison. The study primarily aimed to identify the mandatory nutritional components declared on food labels to ensure compliance with current regulatory requirements. The findings provide valuable insights into food composition, nutrition labeling practices, and reformulation trends within the Spanish food sector, thereby supporting future food monitoring initiatives and evidence-based public health policies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于TABULA™数据库，分析了2022年1月至2023年11月间西班牙市场上超过6,500种预包装食品和饮料的营养成分、标签合规情况及食品配方改良趋势，旨在为公共健康政策和食品监测提供数据支持。
AI.research_question: 西班牙预包装食品和饮料产品的强制性营养成分标签合规情况如何？食品成分和配方改良呈现哪些趋势？
AI.motivation: 通过食品配方改良提升营养质量是促进公共健康的关键策略，但需要系统性的数据监测工具来评估市场变化和监管执行情况，因此开发并应用TABULA™数据库以填补西班牙食品市场的监测空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食品配方改良理论、WHO欧洲区域办事处营养特征模型（Nutrient Profiling Model）用于食品分类和营养评估。
AI.method: 基于TABULA™数据库（2022年1月至2023年11月数据），从主要在线零售平台收集超过6,500种预包装食品和饮料的产品标签信息，采用WHO欧洲区域办事处营养特征模型进行分类，进行描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: 研究识别了食品标签上的强制性营养成分声明情况，揭示了西班牙食品行业的成分组成、营养标签实践和配方改良趋势，为未来的食品监测和循证公共卫生政策提供了重要参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并扩展了WHO营养特征模型在西班牙食品市场的应用，为食品配方改良监测提供了系统化的数据框架和方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西班牙乃至欧洲的食品安全监管机构、公共卫生政策制定者和食品企业提供了关于营养标签合规、食品成分现状及配方改良趋势的实证数据，支持基于证据的公共健康决策。

title: What do we need to know about biodiversity in Economics and Business?
affiliations: , Middlesex University and Faculty of Business, Lingnan University

detail.title: What do we need to know about biodiversity in Economics and Business?
detail.abstract: Purpose: The purpose of this study is to comprehensively review biodiversity-related research within the realms of business, economics, and management from 1993 to 2025. We assess the theoretical underpinnings, intellectual structure, and evolution of the field. It aims to pinpoint crucial theoretical shifts and identify persistent research gaps, focusing on the integration of stakeholder and legitimacy theories, and ecological economics within biodiversity research, while highlighting the shortcomings in addressing corporate accountability and the complexities of biodiversity financialisation. Design/Methodology/Approach: The study utilises bibliometric mapping and systematic literature reviews to explore biodiversity research across business and economic disciplines. We extracted data from Scopus, incorporating articles, books, and conference papers that focus on biodiversity challenges from economic and business perspectives. Using VOSviewer and R for bibliometric analysis, we created visual networks of the intellectual structure and thematic clusters in the field, which allowed for a detailed examination of the evolution and impact of research over time, identifying both influential studies and prominent research gaps. Findings: The findings reveal an increasing alignment of biodiversity research with ecological economics, legitimacy, and stakeholder theories. The research highlights a critical shift from firm-level strategies to systemic transformation needs within economic and financial frameworks, advocating for integrated approaches to biodiversity governance. However, challenges persist, notably in the areas of addressing power asymmetries and corporate greenwashing. Despite a growing emphasis on ecosystem services valuation, the market-based logic frequently overlooks crucial ecological interdependencies and socio-ecological complexities. Originality/Value: The study contributes to the field by offering a structured, theory-driven agenda for future biodiversity research, emphasising the need for universal governance frameworks that transcend traditional firm-level approaches. It uniquely challenges the reductionist market-based logics prevalent in ecosystem services valuation. It calls for a rethinking of economic and financial paradigms to ensure the safeguarding of biodiversity as a core component of economic resilience and planetary stability. A comprehensive bibliometric approach and synthesis of theoretical advancements provide a novel perspective on integrating biodiversity considerations into broader economic and corporate frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量与系统综述，梳理了1993–2025年商业、经济与管理领域的生物多样性研究，发现研究正从企业层面战略向系统性转型发展，虽日益融合生态经济学、合法性与利益相关者理论，但在企业问责、绿色洗白及生物多样性金融化的复杂性方面仍存在显著不足。
AI.research_question: 1993年至2025年间，商业、经济与管理领域的生物多样性研究具有怎样的理论基础、知识结构及演化轨迹？现有研究在企业问责和生物多样性金融化方面存在哪些不足？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性丧失是当前最严峻的全球挑战之一，但商业与经济领域的生物多样性研究相较于气候变化等领域仍不够成熟。作者希望通过全面综述厘清该领域的理论发展脉络，识别研究缺口，推动将生物多样性纳入更广泛的经济与企业框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、合法性理论、生态经济学
AI.method: 文献计量分析（VOSviewer与R）结合系统性文献综述；数据来源为Scopus，涵盖1993–2025年的期刊文章、书籍和会议论文。
AI.findings: (1) 生物多样性研究与生态经济学、合法性和利益相关者理论的融合日益加深；(2) 研究焦点从企业层面战略向经济与金融体系的系统性转型转变；(3) 市场化的生态系统服务价值评估逻辑忽视了关键的生态相互依赖性与社会-生态复杂性；(4) 权力不对称和企业绿色洗白等问题仍未得到充分解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个结构化的、理论驱动的研究议程，挑战了生态系统服务价值评估中主流的两面性市场逻辑，呼吁超越传统企业层面的治理框架，推动经济与金融范式的重新思考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了整合生物多样性治理的明确方向，强调需要建立普适性的治理框架，并将生物多样性作为经济韧性与地球稳定的核心组成部分加以保障。

title: Estimating Demand in the Absence of Sales and Inventory Information
affiliations: Indian School of Business - Operations Management, Indian School of Business and City University of New York (CUNY) - Narendra Paul Loomba Department of Management

detail.title: Estimating Demand in the Absence of Sales and Inventory Information
detail.abstract: Nanostores, the backbone of the retail sector in many emerging economies, face unique operational challenges. These include liquidity and shelf-space constraints, and lack of IT infrastructure such as point-of-sale devices. Consequently, upstream partners responsible for replenishment (such as a manufacturer or its agent) do not have access to sales data and must rely on historical replenishment data to estimate customer demand for replenishment planning. However, replenishment data are subject to two distortions: (i) demand-to-sales distortion due to stockouts, i.e., censoring, and (ii) sales-to-replenishment distortion caused by the retailer's inventory policy. The latter is amplified because nanostores operate at a small scale, while inventory is replenished in relatively large batch sizes. We develop a parsimonious model of the nanostore's inventory dynamics using a modified base-stock policy: the nanostore receives replenishments in batches to reach a target inventory level. Using this model as the data generating process for the replenishment data, we construct a distribution of the unobserved inventory and sales data. We employ the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm to jointly estimate the parameters of the demand distribution and the target inventory level. We find that the EM algorithm misattributes stockouts in some periods involving the maximum observed replenishment quantity and therefore systematically underestimates the target inventory level and correspondingly overestimates the demand. We further show that augmenting the replenishment data with a binary stockout indicator can almost eliminate the upward bias in the demand estimate. Finally, we show that this bias correction can help the upstream partners significantly reduce their visit frequency to the nanostore without adversely impacting the cycle service levels. Our results suggest that manufacturers and distributors can significantly reduce the cost of replenishment to nanostores by more accurately estimating the retail demand with little additional information (i.e., stockout indicators) without making heavy investments in digitization of nanostores with sophisticated POS or inventory management tools.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新兴经济体中"纳米商店"（夫妻老婆店）面临的补货数据失真问题，提出了一种基于EM算法的需求估计方法，并发现通过补充库存短缺指标可以显著修正需求估计偏差，帮助上游供应商在不依赖数字化设备的情况下优化补货策略。
AI.research_question: 在纳米商店（缺乏POS系统、面临流动性约束的小型零售商）中，如何利用存在双重失真（缺货导致的删失和批量补货导致的扭曲）的补货数据来准确估计客户需求？
AI.motivation: 纳米商店是许多新兴经济体零售业的支柱，但面临流动性约束、货架空间有限、缺乏IT基础设施等运营挑战。上游供应商无法获取销售数据，只能依赖历史补货数据估计需求，但补货数据存在两种失真：缺货导致的删失和零售商库存策略导致的扭曲。准确估计需求有助于降低补货成本，而无需对纳米商店进行昂贵的数字化投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于修正的基准库存策略（modified base-stock policy）构建纳米商店库存动态的简约模型；利用期望最大化（EM）算法联合估计需求分布参数和目标库存水平；引入需求删失（censoring）和批量补货扭曲的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建纳米商店库存动态的简约模型（修正的基准库存策略）；使用EM算法联合估计需求分布和目标库存水平；通过模拟和实证分析检验估计偏差；提出引入二元库存短缺指标来修正偏差的方法。
AI.findings: （1）EM算法在涉及最大观测补货量的期间会错误归因缺货，导致系统性地低估目标库存水平并高估需求；（2）在补货数据中补充二元库存短缺指标可以几乎消除需求估计的向上偏差；（3）这种偏差修正可以帮助上游供应商显著降低访问纳米商店的频率，同时不影响周期服务水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在纳米商店情境下，补货数据中最大观测补货量导致的EM算法估计偏差机制；提出了利用库存短缺指标修正需求估计偏差的理论方法，丰富了删失需求估计和库存管理领域的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商和分销商提供了低成本的需求估计改进方案：只需收集库存短缺指标（而非投资昂贵的POS系统），即可显著提高需求估计精度，降低补货成本，优化纳米商店的补货策略和访问频率。

title: Leveraging Trade Credit to Expand Informal Consumer Credit in Base-of-the-Pyramid Retail
affiliations: Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management, Arizona State University (ASU) - Supply Chain Management, University of Colorado at Boulder - Leeds School of Business, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Leveraging Trade Credit to Expand Informal Consumer Credit in Base-of-the-Pyramid Retail
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Informal credit is extended by small independent grocery retailers ("nanostores") to billions of base-of-the-pyramid consumers. We study whether supplier trade credit enables liquidity-constrained nanostore shopkeepers to extend more informal credit to such liquidity-constrained consumers. 

Methodology/results: Through a field experiment with nanostores in Lima, Peru, we find that access to trade credit partly increases the likelihood of consumer credit provision. To understand the behavioral underpinnings of this result, we develop an analytical model in which shopkeepers allocate limited working capital between base consumers, who always pay immediately upon arrival, and additional credit consumers, who pay later but carry default risk. The model predicts that relaxing working capital constraints through trade credit should increase optimal consumer credit provision, with negligible risk of supplier default when credit consumers are profitable on average. We subsequently test these predictions in a behavioral experiment and find systematic deviations from the theoretical benchmark. Participants exhibit mental accounting so that they become more conservative when working capital includes trade credit, discount trade credit more heavily than their own funds, fail to calibrate consumer credit provision  - offering too little (much) when the risk is low (high) - and fail to expand consumer credit provision even when effective capital increases. Examining the heterogeneity of the effect, we find that participants with a positive attitude toward credit are more willing to allocate both trade credit funds and their own working capital toward consumer credit provision. Finally, a simple change in repayment-penalty framing mitigates this mental-accounting effect. 

Managerial implications: Together, the results highlight the challenges shopkeepers face when extending consumer credit and point to behavioral frictions-particularly a repayment shortfall aversion-that would need to be addressed to enhance the pass-through of trade credit to end consumers.

AI.tldr: 通过秘鲁小杂货店的实地实验和行为实验，研究供应商贸易信贷如何影响店主向底层消费者提供非正式信贷，发现贸易信贷部分增加了消费信贷供给，但存在心理账户等行为摩擦导致店主决策偏离理论最优。
AI.research_question: 供应商贸易信贷是否以及如何缓解流动性受限的小型独立杂货店（"纳米店"）店主向流动性受限的底层消费者提供非正式信贷的约束？
AI.motivation: 非正式信贷是全球数十亿底层消费者获取消费品的重要方式，而小店主自身也面临流动性约束。理解贸易信贷能否转化为消费信贷，对于改善底层消费者福利和供应链效率具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）工作资本分配模型：店主在"基础消费者"（立即付款）和"额外信贷消费者"（延迟付款但有违约风险）之间配置有限营运资金；2）心理账户理论：店主对贸易信贷资金和自有资金的心理处理方式不同，导致决策偏差；3）还款短缺厌恶（repayment shortfall aversion）作为行为摩擦的解释机制。
AI.method: 1）秘鲁利马纳米店的实地实验；2）基于分析模型的数学推导；3）受控行为实验（实验室实验），检验理论预测并探索异质性和干预效果。
AI.findings: 1）实地实验：贸易信贷部分增加了店主提供消费信贷的可能性；2）行为实验发现系统性偏差：心理账户效应（贸易信贷资金使用更保守）、对贸易信贷折扣过度、风险校准失灵（低风险时信贷过少、高风险时过多）、即使有效资本增加也未扩大消费信贷；3）异质性：对信贷态度积极的店主更愿分配贸易信贷和自有资金用于消费信贷；4）干预效果：改变还款罚金的表述框架可缓解心理账户效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）在供应链金融与底层经济交叉领域，首次通过实验证据揭示贸易信贷向消费信贷传导的行为摩擦机制；2）将心理账户理论延伸至小零售商信贷决策情境，提出"还款短缺厌恶"概念；3）构建了结合营运资金约束与行为偏差的分析框架，丰富了小微企业融资行为的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为供应商设计贸易信贷政策提供依据，提示需辅以行为干预（如还款框架调整）才能有效促进向终端消费者的信贷传导；2）为政策制定者和非政府组织改善底层消费者信贷可及性提供干预方向；3）揭示小零售商信贷决策中的认知偏误，为金融教育和培训提供针对性内容。

title: Reducing Food Waste Through Profit-Driven Digital Applications
affiliations: University of West Attica

detail.title: Reducing Food Waste Through Profit-Driven Digital Applications
detail.abstract: This paper examines the contribution of new technologies in reducing food waste through real, profit-driven applications in the retail and food service sectors. Based on data from the UN and Eurostat, the environmental and economic footprint of the problem in Greece and the EU is analyzed. Through the description of the Too Good To Go platform, it is highlighted how digital tools provide economic incentives to businesses for managing surplus food. In conclusion, it is proven that technological innovation can successfully align business profitability with environmental sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新技术如何通过零售和餐饮服务领域的实际利润驱动应用来减少食物浪费，以Too Good To Go平台为例，论证了技术创新能够成功地将企业盈利与环境可持续性结合起来。
AI.research_question: 新技术在零售和餐饮服务领域通过利润驱动的方式减少食物浪费的具体贡献是什么？
AI.motivation: 食物浪费在全球范围内造成严重的环境和经济问题，而新技术（尤其是数字平台）如何通过商业激励机制促进减少食物浪费的研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、可持续商业模式理论、循环经济理论
AI.method: 基于联合国和欧盟统计局的数据分析，结合Too Good To Go平台案例描述性分析
AI.findings: 数字工具（如Too Good To Go平台）能够为商家提供管理剩余食物的经济激励；技术创新可以有效协调企业盈利与环境可持续性之间的平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为技术驱动型可持续商业模式提供了理论支持，证明了利润动机与环境目标并非不可调和。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售和餐饮企业提供了利用数字平台减少食物浪费的实践路径，为政策制定者推动可持续食物管理提供了参考。

title: Regulatory Fragmentation, Disclosure Interpretability, and ESG Rating Divergence
affiliations: University of Queensland, Macquarie University and Macquarie University - Department of Applied Finance and Actuarial Studies

detail.title: Regulatory Fragmentation, Disclosure Interpretability, and ESG Rating Divergence

keywords: And ESG Rating Divergence Regulatory Fragmentation

detail.abstract: We examine the informational consequences of firms' regulatory environments for outside ESG evaluation. We argue that divergence across ESG rating agencies reflects not only differences in scope and measurement, but also variation in how tightly disclosures constrain interpretation. When overlapping regulatory regimes weaken interpretive constraint, the same information set may support a broader range of defensible mappings into ESG assessments. Using U.S. public firms from 2001 to 2022, we find that regulatory fragmentation is associated with greater cross-provider ESG rating divergence, and this relation is robust to alternative divergence measures, alternative rating harmonization procedures, and supplementary identification tests. Disclosure-based analyses show that fragmentation is associated with more qualified, litigious, and uncertainty-laden language in mandatory filings, and that the fragmentation-associated components of these features are positively related to subsequent divergence. The relation is weaker in the presence of shareholder attention and sustainability committees. Collectively, the findings suggest that fragmented oversight weakens the common interpretive anchor available to ESG evaluators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业监管环境对ESG评级分歧的影响。当监管碎片化导致信息披露的约束力减弱时，同一套信息可能支持更多样化的ESG评估结果。使用2001-2022年美国上市公司数据发现，监管碎片化与ESG评级分歧正相关，且这种效应受股东注意力和可持续发展委员会等因素调节。
AI.research_question: 企业的监管环境如何影响外部ESG评估的分歧？具体而言，监管碎片化是否以及如何导致不同ESG评级机构之间的评级差异扩大？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将ESG评级分歧归因于评级机构在范围选择和测量方法上的差异，但忽略了监管环境这一制度因素。本文提出，监管环境通过影响信息披露的"解释约束力"（interpretive constraint），进而影响ESG评估的一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露与解释约束的理论框架。核心观点：当存在重叠且碎片化的监管体制时，信息披露的解释约束力被削弱，同一套信息可以支撑多种合理的ESG评估映射，从而导致评级分歧加大。
AI.method: 使用2001-2022年美国上市公司面板数据，采用多种回归分析方法。包括：替代性分歧度量、替代性评级协调方法、补充性识别检验。通过文本分析考察强制性披露中的语言特征（条件性语言、诉讼风险语言、不确定性语言）。
AI.findings: 1. 监管碎片化与跨评级机构的ESG评级分歧正相关，结果稳健；2. 监管碎片化与强制性披露中更多条件性、诉讼性和不确定性语言相关；3. 这些语言特征是后续评级分歧的中介机制；4. 股东注意力和可持续发展委员会的存在削弱了上述关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将ESG评级分歧的研究从评级机构层面的因素拓展到制度环境层面；2. 提出并验证了"解释约束"机制，丰富了信息披露理论在ESG评估中的应用；3. 揭示了监管碎片化对资本市场信息中介的负面外溢效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供了监管协调重要性的证据，提示碎片化监管可能降低ESG信息市场的效率；2. 为企业提供了建立可持续发展委员会等治理机制以缓解评级不确定性的建议；3. 为投资者理解ESG评级分歧的制度根源提供了参考。

title: AutoFactory Dataset to Support AI in Manufacturing Systems
affiliations: Cadi Ayyad University, Cadi Ayyad University and Cadi Ayyad University

detail.title: AutoFactory Dataset to Support AI in Manufacturing Systems
detail.abstract:
Automating code generation in manufacturing systems requires Artificial Intelligence (AI) models capable of interpreting textual requirement specifications. One of the main challenges is the absence of publicly available, domain-specific datasets suitable for training such models. This article presents AutoFactory, an open-source dataset that includes manually written and LLM-augmented requirement specifications, annotated by domain experts for Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks using the BIO format.
AutoFactory enables the extraction and classification of key industrial components, including actuators, pre-actuators, sensors, effectors, and others. These elements correspond to real-world input and output signals in manufacturing systems. The dataset is grounded in realistic scenarios built with Factory I/O and includes 3D scenes, tag tables, and screenshots captured from multiple camera perspectives. To enhance linguistic diversity while preserving semantic intent, all specifications were expanded using large language models and evaluated through semantic similarity analysis (average cosine similarity above 0.92), complemented by manual validation to ensure consistency.
To facilitate the annotation process, a custom labeling tool was developed. It runs locally to preserve data privacy and provides a user-friendly interface. The tool is adaptable to a wide range of NER tasks and allows researchers to customize labels for different domains by adding or modifying tags.
To assess the practical value of the dataset, transformer-based models such as BERT and DistilBERT were fine-tuned on the annotated requirement specifications. The highest-performing model reached an F1-score of 0.95, confirming the dataset’s ability to support accurate identification of key components in manufacturing systems.
This combination of human expertise and AI-based augmentation provides a robust foundation for training AI systems to interpret manufacturing behaviors from text. AutoFactory contributes to ongoing research efforts aimed at enabling intelligent systems to assist in generating control code from requirement specifications, reducing reliance on manual programming in industrial automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AutoFactory，一个面向制造业系统的开放源码数据集，包含人工编写和LLM增强的需求规格说明，并经过领域专家采用BIO格式进行命名实体识别标注，用于从文本中自动提取和分类工业组件，支持智能制造中的代码自动生成。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个公开可用的、面向制造业系统的领域特定数据集，以支持从文本需求规格说明中自动提取关键工业组件？
AI.motivation: 制造业自动化代码生成需要能够解释文本需求规格说明的AI模型，但缺乏公开可用的领域特定数据集是主要挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 命名实体识别（NER）、BIO标注格式、Transformer模型（BERT、DistilBERT）、语义相似度分析
AI.method: 1. 基于Factory I/O构建真实3D场景；2. 人工编写需求规格说明并用LLM扩增以增强语言多样性；3. 领域专家采用BIO格式进行NER标注；4. 开发自定义本地标注工具；5. 使用BERT和DistilBERT进行微调验证。
AI.findings: 最高性能的模型（BERT/DistilBERT微调）达到了0.95的F1分数，验证了数据集能够有效支持关键工业组件的准确识别。语义相似度分析显示平均余弦相似度超过0.92。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个融合人类专家知识和LLM增强方法的开放数据集构建范式，为制造业领域自然语言处理研究奠定了数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 发布AutoFactory开放数据集，填补制造业NER领域的数据空白；2. 提供自定义标注工具，支持数据隐私保护；3. 为从需求规格说明自动生成控制代码的智能系统提供训练基础，减少工业自动化中的人工编程依赖。

reference: Indian journal of Economics and Development, Volume 8, number 2 (2012). Pp 75-85.
title: Consumer Preference Regarding Organised Fresh Fruits and Vegetables Retail Outlets
affiliations: Punjab Agricultural University and Punjab Agricultural University

detail.title: Consumer Preference Regarding Organised Fresh Fruits and Vegetables Retail Outlets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: research was done as faculty member of Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana
declarations.funderStatement: Nil

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indian journal of Economics and Development, Volume 8, number 2 (2012). Pp 75-85.

detail.abstract: The study was conducted with the objective of identifying various factors that influence consumer preferences and variations in consumer preference across different demographic variables for fresh fruits and vegetables from organised retail outlets. The total sample consisted of 150 consumers constituting 75 consumers each from organised and unorganised fruits and vegetables retail stores, respectively. It was found that the most important attributes for selection of stores were product quality, location and variety. Availability of all products under one roof and product variety were the most important factors due to which consumers preferred organised stores over the unorganised ones. It was found that some of the demographic factors such as education, age and income of the consumers determine the consumer preference for organised vis-a vis unorganised fresh fruits and vegetables retail outlets.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了影响消费者对生鲜果蔬零售渠道（有组织 vs 无组织）偏好的因素，发现产品质量、位置和品种是选择店铺的最重要属性，而教育、年龄和收入等人口统计因素会影响消费者的渠道偏好。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响消费者对生鲜果蔬零售渠道的偏好？不同人口统计变量如何导致消费者偏好的差异？
AI.motivation: 随着有组织零售（如连锁超市）的发展，理解消费者在选择有组织与无组织生鲜果蔬零售店时的偏好因素，有助于零售商制定更有效的营销策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、人口统计变量与消费偏好关系理论
AI.method: 问卷调查法，样本量为150名消费者（有组织与无组织零售店各75名）。采用描述性统计和交叉分析等方法。
AI.findings: (1) 选择店铺的最重要属性是产品质量、位置和品种；(2) 一站购齐和产品多样性是消费者偏好有组织门店的主要原因；(3) 教育、年龄和收入等人口统计因素显著影响消费者对零售渠道的选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了人口统计变量（教育、年龄、收入）在生鲜果蔬零售渠道选择中的调节作用，丰富了消费者渠道选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为有组织零售商的定位策略、产品组合优化和目标市场细分提供了实证依据；同时提醒无组织零售商关注产品质量和品种多样性以提升竞争力。

title: Managerial Readiness for AI-Enabled Marketing Decision Systems
affiliations: Manhattan University and Columbia University

detail.title: Managerial Readiness for AI-Enabled Marketing Decision Systems
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping marketing decision-making, yet the readiness of marketing managers to adopt and apply AI remains underexplored. This conceptual paper develops a multidimensional framework of managerial AI readiness, integrating perceived usefulness, data literacy, organizational support, trust in AI, ethical concern, and self-efficacy. Drawing on the Technology Acceptance Model, the Technology-Organization-Environment framework, and social cognitive theory, the paper synthesizes literature and advances theory-driven propositions to guide future research and practice. The model proposes how cognitive, organizational, and ethical factors interact to influence self-efficacy and, in turn, readiness to adopt AI in marketing. The study contributes by extending existing adoption theories with psychological and ethical dimensions, offering a manager-centric perspective often missing in AI research. For practitioners, the framework provides a diagnostic tool to identify capability gaps and guide targeted interventions such as training, culturebuilding, and ethical governance. The paper offers actionable insights for organizations, policymakers, and AI vendors seeking to foster responsible and confident AI adoption in marketing contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多维度的营销经理AI准备度框架，整合感知有用性、数据素养、组织支持、信任、伦理关注和自我效能等要素，为理解和管理营销中AI采纳提供理论指导与实践工具。
AI.research_question: 营销经理对采用和应用AI的准备程度受哪些因素影响？这些因素如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: AI正在重塑营销决策，但营销经理采纳和运用AI的准备程度在现有研究中仍未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）、技术-组织-环境框架（TOE）、社会认知理论（SCT）
AI.method: 概念性论文：文献综合与理论驱动的命题推演
AI.findings: 认知因素（感知有用性）、组织因素（组织支持、数据素养）、伦理因素（伦理关注、信任）通过影响自我效能，进而影响营销经理采纳AI的准备度。
AI.theory_contributions: 在现有采纳理论基础上扩展了心理和伦理维度；提供了现有AI研究中常缺失的以管理者为中心的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个诊断工具，用于识别能力差距，并指导培训、文化建设、伦理治理等针对性干预措施；为组织、政策制定者和AI供应商提供了促进负责任且自信的AI采纳的可操作见解。

title: Structural Causality in Genesis 2-3: A Problem Solving and Corrective Action Approach to the Eden Narrative
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structural Causality in Genesis 2-3: A Problem Solving and Corrective Action Approach to the Eden Narrative
detail.abstract: This study proposes an interdisciplinary approach to biblical exegesis by applying the principles of Problem Solving and Corrective Action (PSCA), a quality management and systems analysis methodology, to the narrative of the human fall in Genesis 2-3. Scholarly discussions of the Eden narrative have long engaged questions concerning the causal structure of the transgression, the function of divine non-intervention during the temptation, and the theological significance of the subsequent judicial decrees. The present study employs the PSCA framework as a heuristic analytical model rather than as a claim regarding the historical intent or compositional methodology of the Genesis author, utilizing contemporary systems analysis to illuminate structural and causal relationships within the biblical text. The investigation proceeds in two stages. First, an Ishikawa (fishbone) analysis identifies contributing factors across the categories of Agent, Method, Measurement, Material, and Environment. Second, a Three-Legged Five Why (3L5Y) investigation traces causal relationships through the interconnected dimensions of the Specific Problem, Detection Failure, and Systemic Failure. This interdisciplinary model is integrated with close literary and lexical analysis of the Hebrew text and supplemented by formal logical representation to examine the coherence of the proposed causal architecture. The study argues that the Eden narrative may be understood as portraying the primordial transgression within an intentionally open covenantal framework in which authentic relationship presupposes genuine human freedom and, consequently, the structural possibility of nonconformance. Within this interpretive model, the divine judgments following the fall function analogously to short-term containment measures, while the proto-evangelium of Genesis 3:15 serves as the narrative's long-term corrective action directed toward the restoration of covenantal and cosmic order. By integrating quality management theory, systems analysis, formal logic, and biblical exegesis, this study offers a novel methodological framework for examining the structural dynamics of the Genesis narrative and demonstrates the potential value of interdisciplinary analytical models for theological interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文运用质量管理中的问题解决与纠正措施（PSCA）框架，分析《创世记》2-3章中的人类堕落叙事，通过鱼骨图和"三足五问"等方法，提出该叙事呈现了一种有意开放的 covenantal 框架，其中神圣审判类似于短期遏制措施，而创世记3:15的原始福音则指向长期纠正行动。
AI.research_question: 如何运用质量管理中的问题解决与纠正措施（PSCA）框架分析《创世记》2-3章中人类堕落叙事的因果关系结构？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，学术界围绕伊甸园叙事中的犯罪因果结构、神在诱惑期间的不干预以及后续审判的神学意义存在诸多争议，需要一种新的跨学科分析框架来阐明文本中的结构性和因果性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 问题解决与纠正措施（PSCA）框架，包括石川（鱼骨）图和三足五问（3L5Y）因果分析方法。
AI.method: 第一阶段：运用石川（鱼骨）分析法，从Agent（行动者）、Method（方法）、Measurement（衡量）、Material（物质）和Environment（环境）五个类别识别贡献因素；第二阶段：运用三足五问（3L5Y）法，通过具体问题、检测失败和系统性失败三个相互关联的维度追踪因果关系。同时结合希伯来文本的文学与词汇分析，以及形式逻辑表达。
AI.findings: 伊甸园叙事可以被理解为在一种有意开放的 covenant 框架中描绘了原初的过犯——真正的盟约关系以人的真实自由为前提，因此必然存在不顺从的结构性可能性；神圣审判类似于短期遏制措施；创世记3:15的原始福音作为叙事的长期纠正行动，指向恢复 covenant 和宇宙秩序。
AI.theory_contributions: 将质量管理理论与系统分析方法引入圣经诠释学，提供了一个全新的跨学科方法论框架，可用于分析圣经叙事中的结构动力学。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了质量管理分析工具（如鱼骨图和5Why分析）在非商业领域（神学文本诠释）中的应用潜力，为跨学科分析模型在神学诠释中的价值提供了示范。

title: Should Demand Models Incorporate Competitor Prices? Oblivious Learning and Algorithmic Collusion
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Decision Risk and Operations and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Decision Risk and Operations

detail.title: Should Demand Models Incorporate Competitor Prices? Oblivious Learning and Algorithmic Collusion
detail.abstract: On a platform with many sellers, should a pricing algorithm explicitly model competitors' prices when learning demand? Classical learning arguments suggest an affirmative answer: ignoring competitors induces model misspecification and inefficiency. In contrast, recent work on algorithmic collusion suggests that strategic obliviousness---deliberately ignoring competitor prices---may facilitate collusive outcomes and improve profits. We study this modeling choice in a stylized competitive market with unknown noisy demand, in which multiple sellers repeatedly set prices and estimate demand via iterated least squares, and either incorporate competitors' prices into their demand models (informed) or ignore them (oblivious). We first show that, relative to a monopolist, an oblivious seller in a competitive market must explore more aggressively to compensate for the loss of dynamic competitor information. Building on this insight, we characterize market dynamics when all sellers are oblivious and show that prices converge to the competitive outcome under sufficient exploration, while a continuum of pseudo-equilibria arises when exploration decays. Analyzing the resulting price trajectories, we uncover an excursion phenomenon that gives rise to transient collusive patterns that dissipate as learning progresses. In markets with both oblivious and informed sellers, the informed strictly out-earn the oblivious. Read as a strategy game, the modeling choice has a unique Nash equilibrium: the all-informed market, in which prices converge to the competitive outcome efficiently. Overall, our results indicate that collusive patterns are not robust and are not sustained by oblivious modeling; therefore, incorporating competitor information, together with sufficient price exploration, remains a reliable strategy for sellers in competitive markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了竞争市场中卖家定价算法是否应显式建模竞争对手价格。结果表明，忽略竞争对手价格虽可能产生短暂合谋模式，但最终会消散；而纳入竞争对手信息并充分探索价格才是可靠策略，全知情市场是唯一纳什均衡。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性平台上，卖家的定价算法是否应该显式地建模竞争对手的价格？即知情（informed）与忽视（oblivious）两种建模策略孰优孰劣？
AI.motivation: 经典学习理论认为忽略竞争对手会导致模型误设和效率损失，而近期关于算法合谋的研究则表明战略性忽视竞争对手价格可能促进合谋并提高利润。这一矛盾促使作者系统研究该建模选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于迭代最小二乘法的需求学习模型；竞争市场动态定价理论；算法合谋理论；纳什均衡博弈分析。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学分析：构建多卖家重复定价的竞争市场模型，对比知情（含竞争对手价格）与忽视（不含竞争对手价格）两种需求学习策略，分析市场动态、价格收敛性及博弈均衡。
AI.findings: （1）忽视型卖家需更激进地探索价格以补偿缺失的竞争信息；（2）全忽视市场中，充分探索下价格收敛至竞争性结果，探索衰减时出现连续统伪均衡；（3）存在价格"偏离（excursion）"现象，产生短暂合谋模式但随学习消散；（4）混合市场中知情卖家利润严格高于忽视型；（5）全知情市场是唯一纳什均衡，价格高效收敛至竞争结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较了竞争市场中知情与忽视两种定价建模策略，揭示了合谋模式的不稳健性，证明了全知情市场是博弈的独特纳什均衡，为算法定价设计提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对平台和卖家的启示：忽视竞争对手价格的算法虽可能产生短暂合谋，但不可持续且利润更低；纳入竞争对手信息并保持充分的价格探索是更可靠的定价策略。

title: Who Invited the Lawyer? Essential Qualifications of Modern General Counsels

detail.title: Who Invited the Lawyer? Essential Qualifications of Modern General Counsels

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares they have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved and conducted in accordance with an Institutional Review Board protocol. Study participants executed a written consent prior to their participation.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no external funding for this study.

detail.abstract: In the view of many institutional stakeholders, the lawyers are everywhere. As liability concerns permeate organizational decision making, decision makers increasingly rely on their in-house lawyers. Limited empirical research has considered what qualifies attorneys-typically individuals with little-to-no experience as institutional administrators-to accrue executive-level status and influence in matters of legal, legal-adjacent, and extra-legal concern. To better understand the qualities and qualifications of modern general counsels (GCs), an empirical qualitative multiple case study was conducted in the complex institutional context of U.S. research universities to understand the expansive influence of their GCs. The cases of six highly experienced, incumbent GCs were explored to understand how GCs perceive and experience the skills, qualities, and experiences that qualify them for such a highly influential executive role. The findings revealed 15 discrete GC role qualifications distributed among four categories: (1) technical skills and competencies, (2) dispositional qualities, (3) relational abilities, and (4) executive capacities. A new conceptual framework is proposed, depicting the qualities and qualifications of modern GCs and the relationship of these qualities and qualifications to GCs' exercise of executive influence.

AI.tldr: 通过对六所美国研究型大学的案例研究，揭示了现代法律总顾问（GCs）获得高管影响力的四类15项资格条件，并提出了新的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 什么样技能、素质和经验使法律总顾问（GCs）能够在机构中担任具有高度影响力的高管角色？
AI.motivation: 尽管律师在机构决策中日益重要，但鲜有实证研究探讨那些通常没有机构管理经验的律师如何获得高管级别的地位和影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多案例研究的归纳分析，提出包含技术技能、性情特质、关系能力和执行能力四类资格条件的新的概念框架。
AI.method: 质性多案例研究，对美国六所研究型大学中经验丰富的现任法律总顾问进行深度探索。
AI.findings: 识别出15项具体的GC角色资格条件，分为四类：技术技能与能力、性情特质、关系能力、执行能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出现代法律总顾问资格条件的新概念框架，阐明这些资格与GC行使高管影响力之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校及其他复杂组织选拔、培养法律总顾问提供明确的资格标准参考；帮助理解律师如何在组织中发挥超越法律事务的广泛影响力。

title: A Computational Model for Risk-based Quality Governance Assessment in High-risk Infrastructure Projects: A Weighted Composite Scoring Approach
affiliations: University of Essex

detail.title: A Computational Model for Risk-based Quality Governance Assessment in High-risk Infrastructure Projects: A Weighted Composite Scoring Approach
detail.abstract: High-risk infrastructure projects, characterized by their complexity, substantial investment, and extended timelines, necessitate robust quality governance frameworks to mitigate potential failures and ensure successful delivery [1]. Traditional governance models often struggle to integrate the dynamic interplay of risk factors with quality assurance mechanisms across the project lifecycle. This paper introduces a computational model designed for risk-based quality governance assessment in such projects. The model employs a weighted composite scoring approach, systematically evaluating various dimensions of quality governance against identified project-specific risks. It synthesizes quantitative metrics and qualitative indicators, transforming complex risk landscapes into actionable governance scores. The methodology encompasses indicator selection, an algorithm for composite score calculation, and a multi-stage validation process. Application through simulated case studies demonstrates the model's capacity to provide a nuanced, real-time assessment of governance efficacy, identifying vulnerabilities and guiding strategic interventions. This approach supports project stakeholders in making informed decisions, thereby enhancing project resilience and reducing the likelihood of adverse outcomes. The model contributes a structured, quantifiable method for proactively managing quality governance in critical infrastructure developments. To operate this concept, the proposed model integrates governance indicators, risk criticality metrics, and decision-weighting mechanisms within a computational decision-support architecture. Specifically, the model combines expert-derived governance indicators with probabilistic risk assessment to compute a normalized Weighted Composite Score (WCS) representing governance effectiveness under risk exposure. Sensitivity analysis and Monte Carlo simulation are incorporated to evaluate the robustness of governance scoring under uncertain project conditions. This computational structure enables systematic benchmarking of governance performance across infrastructure projects with varying risk profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于风险的质量治理评估计算模型，通过加权综合评分方法，整合定量与定性指标，用于高风险基础设施项目的质量治理评估，并通过模拟案例验证了模型的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个计算模型，对高风险基础设施项目的质量治理进行基于风险的量化评估？
AI.motivation: 传统治理模型难以有效整合风险因素与质量保障机制在整个项目生命周期中的动态交互，需要一种结构化、可量化的方法来主动管理质量治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加权综合评分法、概率风险评估、敏感性分析、蒙特卡洛模拟
AI.method: 指标选择 → 综合评分算法设计 → 多阶段验证；整合专家治理指标与概率风险评估，计算归一化加权综合评分（WCS），并引入敏感性分析和蒙特卡洛模拟评估治理评分在不确定条件下的稳健性。
AI.findings: 模型能够提供细粒度、实时的治理效能评估，识别脆弱性并指导战略干预；支持不同风险特征的基础设施项目之间的治理绩效系统化基准比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将风险因素与质量治理评估系统整合的计算框架，将复杂风险景观转化为可操作的治理评分，为风险治理评估领域提供了结构化的量化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助项目利益相关者做出更明智的决策，增强项目韧性，降低不良后果的发生概率；支持跨项目治理绩效的基准比较。

title: Revealing the Right Wrongs: Norm Violations Involving Unconventional Behaviors Boost Leader Authenticity and Voter Support
affiliations: ESADE Business School, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Dresden University and University of Vienna

detail.title: Revealing the Right Wrongs: Norm Violations Involving Unconventional Behaviors Boost Leader Authenticity and Voter Support
detail.abstract: Although norm violators are typically censured, leaders and politicians often publicly selfdisclose past norm violations. Could such revelations be strategically advantageous? Across five studies, we examine whether disclosing prior norm violations enhances leaders' perceived authenticity and downstream support. We distinguish unconventional norm violations (e.g., wearing sweatpants to a black-tie event) from antisocial violations (e.g., nepotism), personal vulnerabilities (e.g., being mugged), and neutral self-disclosures (e.g., hobbies), holding negativity constant across conditions. Results show that leaders who disclosed unconventional norm violations were perceived as significantly more authentic than leaders who disclosed other types of information. Importantly, this authenticity boost was unique to voluntary self-disclosure: it disappeared when identical information was revealed through media reports (Study 1) or direct observation (Study 2), highlighting the critical role of intentional revelation. Further, the effect was stronger for leaders than for non-leaders (Study 3), suggesting that leaders can leverage accumulated idiosyncrasy credits to come clean about prior misgivings in ways that signal authenticity rather than deviance. Finally, perceptions of authenticity translated into meaningful behavioral outcomes: leaders who disclosed unconventional violations received greater support and endorsement than comparison leaders (Studies 4a-4b). Our findings demonstrate that not all norm violations are equal and that unconventional violations, when selfdisclosed by leaders, can function as a reputational asset rather than a liability. This research advances counter-normative influence theory by identifying perceived authenticity as a novel psychological mechanism linking norm violations to positive outcomes, and by clarifying when and for whom norm violations can increase, rather than decrease, leader endorsement.

AI.tldr: 领导者公开自曝非常规性违规行为（如穿运动裤参加正式晚宴），会通过增强真实性感知来获得更多支持，这不同于反社会性违规或被动曝光；这种效应依赖于自愿披露、领导者身份和非常规违规类型。
AI.research_question: 领导者公开自曝过去的违规行为是否以及在何种条件下会转化为战略优势（而非声誉损失）？
AI.motivation: 现实中领导人常公开披露自己过去的违规行为，这与"违规者应受谴责"的常识相悖，因此需要解释这种看似矛盾的现象背后的心理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反规范影响理论（counter-normative influence theory）、真实性感知、异质性信用（idiosyncrasy credits）
AI.method: 5项实验研究，控制负面性在不同条件下保持不变，对比不同类型的违规/信息披露，并操纵披露方式（自愿vs.第三方曝光）、身份（领导者vs.非领导者）。
AI.findings: 1）自曝非常规违规（vs.反社会违规、个人脆弱性、中性信息）显著提升真实性感知；2）该效应依赖于自愿披露（媒体曝光或直接观察时消失）；3）领导者比非领导者效应更强（可动用异质性信用）；4）真实性感知转化为更多支持与认可。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出"真实性感知"作为连接违规行为与积极结果的新心理机制；拓展了反规范影响理论，明确了违规行为何时（自愿、非常规）以及为谁（领导者）能增加而非减少支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者和管理者提供了关于如何策略性披露个人历史中非常规行为的实用指导；揭示了并非所有违规披露都会造成声誉损失，恰当类型的自曝可以成为声誉资产。

title: Stress and Coping Mechanisms Among HR Professionals in India
affiliations: , ,  and Schizophrenia Research Foundation (SCARF)

detail.title: Stress and Coping Mechanisms Among HR Professionals in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study received ethical approval from the Schizophrenia Research Foundation India (SCARF) Institutional Ethics Committee (Protocol no. SRF/SR-09/July 2025) on July 29th, 2025. All participants provided written informed consent prior to participating.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Within corporate workplaces, Human Resource (HR) professionals balance a range of responsibilities, spanning employee wellbeing, recruitment, and administrative tasks. Given the digitalization of their roles and the increased focus on employee wellbeing since COVID-19, HR professionals are prone to stress and burnout, especially in large workplaces. There is a lack of research with HR professionals across India focusing on their experience of stress and coping within their roles. This study aimed to understand the nature of stress faced by Indian HR professionals and strategies they use to cope. Using a mixed methods design, stress levels and common coping strategies were assessed, while interviews provided detailed insight into personal experiences. 79% of HR professionals experienced moderate or high stress. Common stressors included work-related demands, boundary-related challenges, and interpersonal challenges. Organizational culture and personal adaptive or coping styles have the potential to reduce stress. HRs largely used independent ways to cope with challenges. They commonly engaged in active coping, acceptance, and positive reframing to cope with stress, yet there was a relation between higher perceived stress and engaging in negative coping strategies such as behavioral disengagement and self-blame. As stigma around mental health persists, leadership must implement specialized support for HR professionals to facilitate usage of workplace mental health services.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合研究方法，发现79%的印度HR专业人士承受中高度压力，主要压力源包括工作要求、边界挑战和人际挑战，他们多采用独立应对方式（积极应对、接受、积极重构），但高压力与消极应对策略（行为脱离、自责）相关，建议领导层为HR提供专业心理健康支持。
AI.research_question: 印度HR专业人士在工作中面临的压力性质是什么？他们采用哪些应对策略？
AI.motivation: HR专业人士承担员工福祉、招聘和行政等多重职责，数字化转型和疫情后对员工福祉的重视使其易受压力和倦怠影响，但针对印度HR专业人士压力与应对的研究缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 压力与应对理论（如Lazarus的认知交互理论）、组织文化对压力的调节作用、心理健康污名化理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：量化评估（压力水平和常见应对策略）与质性访谈（个人经历深度洞察）相结合。
AI.findings: 1) 79%的HR专业人士经历中高度压力；2) 主要压力源为工作要求、边界挑战和人际挑战；3) 组织文化和个人适应/应对风格可缓解压力；4) HR多采用独立应对方式，常见积极应对、接受和积极重构；5) 高压力与消极应对策略（行为脱离、自责）相关；6) 心理健康污名化依然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了印度HR专业人士这一特定群体的压力与应对机制，补充了非西方背景下HR职业压力的理论研究，验证了压力水平与消极应对策略之间的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议领导层为HR实施专业支持措施，促进其使用工作场所心理健康服务，以缓解职业压力和倦怠。

title: Connecting Internal Branding with Employee Brand Performance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and OSSIAM

detail.title: Connecting Internal Branding with Employee Brand Performance
detail.abstract: Purpose-Although, there is evidence that internal branding (IB) influences and effects employees' brand-supportive behaviors, it is still unknown what determines employees' brand performance (EBP). Moreover, a mediator is assessed in relation to how IB practices affect EBP. Design/methodology/approach-The study examines the banking sector in Pakistan, the authors performed Partial Least Squares (PLS) to analyze 426 bank staff data. Findings-The results reveal that an effective IB strategy leverages EBP and BC. However, brand trust and brand identification do not directly leverage EBP. Practical implication: By incorporating brand attitudes and implementing a robust IB strategy, firms can enhance EBP. These initiatives are not just the sole responsibility of the brand manager, but instead a collective responsibility of all employees at all levels. Managers of financial services firms are recommended to pursue IB strategy actively rather than let it become a passive function of human resources. Originality/value-This research fills a gap in our understanding by bringing together two underresearched areas in the banking industry namely, IB and EBP. It reveals the significance of creating an internal brand at a corporate level and also proposes the antecedents of EBP and clarifies the relationships among them. This research lends credence to the idea that implementing IB might be a valuable strategy that can be used by service firms in their efforts to better their staff's brand performance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨内部品牌建设（IB）如何影响员工品牌绩效（EBP），以巴基斯坦银行业为背景，发现有效的IB策略能提升EBP和品牌承诺（BC），但品牌信任和品牌认同并不直接促进EBP。
AI.research_question: 内部品牌建设（IB）如何影响员工品牌绩效（EBP）？其中品牌承诺（BC）是否起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明内部品牌建设会影响员工的品牌支持行为，但决定员工品牌绩效的因素尚不明确，且IB对EBP的作用机制（中介路径）缺乏探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部品牌建设理论、品牌承诺、品牌信任、品牌认同
AI.method: 以巴基斯坦银行业为样本，采用偏最小二乘法（PLS）分析426名银行员工数据。
AI.findings: （1）有效的内部品牌建设策略能提升员工品牌绩效和品牌承诺；（2）品牌信任和品牌认同并不直接提升员工品牌绩效；（3）品牌承诺在IB与EBP之间起中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将内部品牌建设与员工品牌绩效两个在银行业中研究不足的领域联系起来；（2）揭示了企业层面打造内部品牌的重要性；（3）提出了EBP的前因变量并厘清了它们之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）企业可通过融入品牌态度并实施强有力的内部品牌策略来提升员工品牌绩效；（2）品牌建设不只是品牌经理的责任，而是全体员工的责任；（3）金融服务企业管理者应主动推行内部品牌战略，而非将其视为人力资源部门的被动职能。

title: Enabler or impediment? ESG practices and green innovation in Chinese manufacturing firms: A longitudinal study under visibility
affiliations: School of Management, Xian Jiaotong University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Enabler or impediment? ESG practices and green innovation in Chinese manufacturing firms: A longitudinal study under visibility
detail.abstract: Abstract This study investigates the relationship between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices and organizational performance (OP), focusing on the mediating role of organizational green innovation (OGI) and the moderating role of organizational visibility (OV). ESG practices have emerged as strategic mechanisms through which organizations pursue sustainable innovation and long-term competitiveness. Drawing on stakeholder theory, the resource-based view (RBV), natural resource-based view (NRBV), and institutional theory, the study analyzes longitudinal panel data from 752 Chinese manufacturing firms comprising 18,716 firm-year observations (2001-2025) using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The findings demonstrate that ESG practices significantly enhance organizational green innovation and organizational performance, while organizational green innovation partially mediates the ESG-performance relationship, highlighting innovation as a key mechanism through which ESG creates organizational value. Furthermore, organizational visibility negatively moderates the direct relationship between ESG and performance, indicating that heightened stakeholder scrutiny and legitimacy pressures reduce performance benefits derived from ESG initiatives, even as ESG engagement itself remains beneficial. Robustness analyses across state-owned and private enterprises confirm the stability of these findings, with private firms demonstrating stronger green innovation-to-performance conversion. These findings reveal that while ESG practices enable green innovation and knowledge creation, the moderating role of organizational visibility operates primarily as a negative boundary condition on the direct ESG-performance pathway. The findings also provide practical implications for managers and policymakers seeking to leverage ESG-driven innovation to support sustainable industrial transformation and contribute to SDG 9 (industry, innovation, and infrastructure) and SDG 12 (responsible consumption and production) in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于752家中国制造业企业2001-2025年的面板数据，发现ESG实践通过组织绿色创新的部分中介作用提升组织绩效，而组织可见性负面调节ESG与绩效的直接关系——高可见性带来的利益相关者审视压力削弱了ESG的绩效收益。
AI.research_question: ESG实践如何影响组织绩效？组织绿色创新在其中起何种中介作用？组织可见性如何调节ESG与绩效之间的关系？
AI.motivation: ESG实践已成为企业追求可持续创新和长期竞争力的战略机制，但ESG通过何种路径创造组织价值、在何种边界条件下效力减弱尚不明确，尤其在发展中国家的制造业情境中缺乏大样本纵向研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、资源基础观（RBV）、自然资源基础观（NRBV）、制度理论
AI.method: 纵向面板数据分析，样本为752家中国制造业企业共18,716个公司-年度观测值（2001-2025年），采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行实证检验，并进行了国有与民营企业的稳健性分析。
AI.findings: (1) ESG实践显著提升组织绿色创新和组织绩效；(2) 组织绿色创新部分中介ESG与绩效的关系；(3) 组织可见性负面调节ESG与绩效的直接关系，即高可见性削弱了ESG的绩效收益；(4) 民营企业中绿色创新向绩效的转化效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合多重理论视角（利益相关者理论、RBV、NRBV、制度理论），揭示了绿色创新作为ESG价值创造的关键中介机制，同时识别出组织可见性作为ESG-绩效关系的负面边界条件，丰富了ESG与可持续创新领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供如何通过ESG驱动的绿色创新促进可持续发展的实践指导；为政策制定者在新兴经济体中推动工业可持续转型、实现SDG 9（产业、创新与基础设施）和SDG 12（负责任消费与生产）提供实证依据。

title: Heterogeneity in Consumers' Economic Expectations across Euro Area Countries
affiliations: Leibniz University Hannover, National Bank of Slovakia, Leibniz  Universität Hannover and Bank of Finland - Research

detail.title: Heterogeneity in Consumers' Economic Expectations across Euro Area Countries
detail.abstract: This paper examines crosscountry differences in consumer expectations about macroeconomic outcomes and mortgage borrowing conditions within a monetary union. Using harmonized microdata from the ECB Consumer Expectations Survey for eleven euro area countries, we document significant national disparities. By sequentially adding a rich set of consumer-and country-specific macro controls to pooled regressions with country fixed effects, we find that these factors account for much, but not all, of the crosscountry heterogeneity in expectations. These remaining differences likely reflect unobserved countryspecific factors, highlighting the need for country-tailored monetary policy communication to effectively stabilize consumer expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧洲央行消费者预期调查的微观数据，分析了欧元区11国消费者对宏观经济和抵押贷款条件的预期差异，发现国家异质性大部分可被消费者和国家层面因素解释，但仍存在未观测到的国别因素，表明需要针对不同国家的货币政策沟通来稳定消费者预期。
AI.research_question: 在货币联盟内，各国消费者对宏观经济结果和抵押贷款条件的预期存在怎样的跨国差异？这些差异在多大程度上能被消费者特征和国家宏观经济因素所解释？
AI.motivation: 尽管欧元区实施统一的货币政策，但消费者预期仍存在显著的跨国差异，这会影响货币政策传导效果。理解这些差异的来源对于优化货币政策沟通策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者预期形成理论；货币政策传导机制理论；国家异质性与统一货币政策之间的张力。
AI.method: 使用欧洲央行消费者预期调查（ECB Consumer Expectations Survey）的11个欧元区国家微观数据，通过逐步加入消费者层面和国家层面宏观控制变量，进行包含国家固定效应的混合回归分析。
AI.findings: 消费者和国家层面的因素解释了大部分（但非全部）跨国预期异质性；剩余差异可能源于未观测到的国家特定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币联盟内消费者预期异质性的来源提供了实证证据，丰富了关于统一货币政策下预期形成机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出即使在同一货币区内，货币政策沟通也需要针对不同国家进行定制化设计，以提高政策传导的有效性。

title: Innovation without Borders? The Geography of Technological Diffusion
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Harvard University - Business School (HBS), Goethe University Frankfurt, European Central Bank (ECB), University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Innovation without Borders? The Geography of Technological Diffusion
detail.abstract: How well does innovation diffuse across geographic boundaries? To shed light on this question, we present a large-scale field experiment involving 3,300 firms across twelve European Union countries. We elicit firms' perceptions of the share of similar firms in their own country that had invested in artificial intelligence (AI), as well as the corresponding share among similar firms in Germany, France, and Italy. We randomly provide half of the sample with accurate information about both domestic and foreign AI investment. We show that firms substantially underestimate competitors' current AI investment, both domestically and abroad, and that they update their expectations about competitors' future AI investment in response to the information treatment. The treatment also causes a statistically significant increase in firms' own expected AI investment rate (p-value < 0.001). We find strong strategic complementarities within borders: a 1 pp increase in the expected share of domestic peers investing in AI raises a firm's own expected AI investment rate by 0.570 pp. These complementarities are absent across borders: the effect of an increase in the expected share of foreign peers investing in AI on a firm's own expected AI investment rate is statistically insignificant. Overall, our evidence shows that innovation diffusion and strategic complementarities in AI investment are much stronger domestically than internationally.

AI.tldr: 通过覆盖12个欧盟国家3300家企业的实地实验，发现企业显著低估了国内外竞争对手的AI投资水平。信息干预后，企业提高了自身预期AI投资率。战略性互补效应在国内显著（国内同行每增加1个百分点AI投资预期，企业自身预期提高0.570个百分点），但在国际间不显著。创新扩散和战略互补在国内远强于国际。
AI.research_question: 创新在地理边界上的扩散效果如何？战略性互补在AI投资中是否跨越国界？
AI.motivation: 创新扩散是否受地理边界限制是重要的经济学问题，但缺乏因果证据。现有研究多关注国内扩散，对国际间战略性互补的实证检验不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略性互补理论：企业的投资决策受竞争对手投资预期的影响。如果战略性互补存在，企业会随着竞争对手增加投资而增加自身投资。
AI.method: 大规模实地实验：覆盖12个欧盟国家的3300家企业。实验组获得国内外AI投资的真实信息，对照组未获得。通过问卷调查企业的投资预期变化。
AI.findings: 1. 企业显著低估国内外竞争对手的AI投资。2. 信息干预显著提升企业自身预期AI投资率（p<0.001）。3. 国内战略性互补效应显著（弹性0.570），国际间不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过实地实验因果识别出创新扩散和战略性互补在国内与国际之间的不对称性，为战略性互补理论补充了地理边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：促进国内创新扩散（如行业信息共享、产业政策）比单纯推动跨国合作可能更有效；企业应更关注本国竞争对手的动态。

reference: 19 J. Tort L. 43 (2026); Journal of Tort Law, Vol. 19, No. 1, pp. 43-77, 2026 [10.1515/jtl-2025-0011]; Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
title: Moral Progress in Legal Doctrine
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: Moral Progress in Legal Doctrine

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Tort Law, Vol. 19, No. 1, pp. 43-77, 2026 [10.1515/jtl-2025-0011]
Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article integrates the concept of moral progresshere, moral improvement in the thinking and behavior of individuals over timeinto the study of legal doctrine. The article first presents a naturalistic account of what moral progress is and describes three of its most historically and analytically important forms: (1) moral circle expansion, (2) moral domain expansion, and (3) increasing sensitivity to proportionality. The article then analyzes three historical developments in U.S. tort law that qualify as instances of moral progress: (1) the partial demise of the "suicide rule" beginning around the 1980s (according to the article, an episode of moral circle expansion), (2) the liberalization of recovery for emotional harm in the negligent infliction tort beginning around the 1970s (moral domain expansion), and (3) the near-total replacement of contributory negligence by comparative negligence throughout the twentieth century (increasing sensitivity to proportionality). The article ends by outlining three legal scholarly implications of the analysis. (1) Legal scholars may be able to use the concept of moral progress as a criterion for making internal as opposed to external criticisms of tort law. (2) Attending to historical moral progress in an area of law facilitates sounder assessment of the area's present-day moral value. (3) Studying moral progress in legal doctrine can identify open legal historical questions about historical legal actors' motives. More generally, this article can inform legal scholars who seek to analyze morally progressive or regressive change in any area of law.

AI.tldr: 本文将"道德进步"概念（个人在思想和行为上随时间的道德改善）引入法律教义研究，分析了三种道德进步形式（道德圈扩张、道德领域扩张、对比例性敏感度提升）在美国侵权法中的三个历史实例，并探讨了其法学学术启示。
AI.research_question: 如何将道德进步概念系统性地纳入法律教义分析，以及道德进步在侵权法中如何具体体现？
AI.motivation: 法律学者在评价法律发展时缺乏一个系统的道德进步框架，本文旨在填补这一空白，为法律教义的道德评估提供理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德进步理论（包括道德圈扩张、道德领域扩张、比例敏感性提升）、侵权法教义分析、法律与道德交叉理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与历史案例分析相结合，通过自然主义道德进步概念框架分析美国侵权法历史上的三个具体发展实例。
AI.findings: 美国侵权法中三个典型道德进步案例：（1）1980年代"自杀规则"的部分废止（道德圈扩张）；（2）1970年代以来过失致情绪损害精神损害赔偿的自由化（道德领域扩张）；（3）20世纪比较过失对共同过失的替代（比例敏感性提升）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将道德进步理论系统引入法律教义分析，提供了区分法律内部批评与外部批评的新标准，揭示了法律史研究中关于历史行动者动机的新问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律学者评估特定法律领域的当下道德价值提供了历史分析工具，为分析任何法律领域的道德进步或倒退变化提供了方法框架。

title: EMOTIF: A Real-World Facial Emotion Recognition Dataset
affiliations: Mohammed V University of Rabat National School of Computer Science and Systems Analysis, Mohammed V University of Rabat National School of Computer Science and Systems Analysis, Mohammed V University of Rabat National School of Computer Science and Systems Analysis and International University of Rabat

detail.title: EMOTIF: A Real-World Facial Emotion Recognition Dataset
detail.abstract: Facial expression recognition remains a core challenge in computer vision, but it's becoming more important in security, adaptive learning, mental health evaluation, and interactive systems. Deep learning models work well, but genuine progress is still restricted by the fact that existing datasets typically don't show the full range and complexity of real-world emotional expressions. A lot of them had unbalanced emotion classifications, not enough variety in context, and were collected in very controlled settings that don't reflect how things are in the real world. A lot of benchmarks just look at Ekman's six main feelings. This limits the range and difficulty that models need to work well in real life. To solve these difficulties, we provide EMOTIF, a collection of real-world facial expressions that shows 15 different emotions in diverse settings. Using advanced detection and annotation methods, an automated processing system created accurate and full emotion data. The FYOLOv5 model (Face: You Only Look Once) is a fast, first-pass detector that performs well for identifying faces in real time and in tough settings. This is basically what it does. Because of this, YOLOv11, a more complex model, makes bounding box predictions better, making sure that face areas are retrieved correctly and with a lot of information. This hybrid detection method creates a well-organized, full dataset that is a great starting point for building reliable, context-aware face emotion recognition algorithms and for making affective computing applications work better in real life.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EMOTIF数据集，包含15种情绪的真实世界面部表情，并采用FYOLOv5和YOLOv11混合检测方法构建高质量数据集，以解决现有数据集情绪类别少、环境受限等问题，提升面部表情识别在真实场景中的表现。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个覆盖多种情绪类别、反映真实世界复杂性的面部表情数据集，以提升深度学习模型在实际场景中的表情识别能力？
AI.motivation: 现有面部表情数据集存在情绪分类不均衡、场景单一、大多仅覆盖Ekman六种基本情绪等问题，限制模型在真实世界中的泛化能力。需要更丰富、更真实的数据集来推动表情识别技术的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习（尤其是YOLO系列目标检测算法）、面部表情识别、情感计算
AI.method: 提出了EMOTIF数据集，包含15种情绪的真实世界面部表情；采用两级检测流水线：先用FYOLOv5进行快速初检，再用YOLOv11优化边界框预测，实现高精度的面部区域提取。
AI.findings: EMOTIF数据集覆盖了15种不同情绪，场景多样且更具真实世界复杂度；FYOLOv5+YOLOv11的混合检测方法能够高效准确地提取面部区域，为构建鲁棒的、上下文感知的面部表情识别模型提供了坚实基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了面部表情识别研究中情绪类别的范围（从6种扩展到15种）；提出了自动化的混合检测流水线用于高质量数据集构建；为真实场景下的情感计算研究提供了理论和数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安全监控、自适应学习、心理健康评估、交互式系统等应用提供了更真实、更全面的面部表情数据集和检测方案；有助于开发在真实世界中表现更好的情感计算系统。

title: Interactive Effects of Emotional Involvement and Expected Value on Moral Decision-Making: Evidence for Sex Differences from tDCS
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Henan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Interactive Effects of Emotional Involvement and Expected Value on Moral Decision-Making: Evidence for Sex Differences from tDCS
detail.abstract: The medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) has been implicated in both emotional processing and value-based evaluation during moral decision-making, yet its causal role in integrating these processes remains unclear. This experiment tested two hypotheses: first, that the mPFC causally mediates a dynamic shift between emotional and value-based processing; second, that this neural mechanism differs between female and male participants. Seventy-two participants (36 female, 36 male) completed a moral decision-making task involving personal and impersonal moral dilemmas while receiving 25-minute cathodal or sham transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) over the mPFC. Expected value was manipulated through magnitude. Results showed that cathodal tDCS reduced utilitarian tendencies under conditions of low emotional involvement and high expected value, whereas it increased utilitarian tendencies under conditions of high emotional involvement and low expected value. These effects were observed only in female participants. The findings indicate that the mPFC plays a causal and context-dependent role in moral decision-making by dynamically integrating emotional involvement and value-based information. Furthermore, sex-specific effects suggest partially distinct neural mechanisms in female and male participants during moral judgment. These results advance understanding of the brain–cognition mechanisms underlying moral decision-making by demonstrating how the mPFC flexibly reweights emotional and value-related information across moral contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）抑制或假刺激内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC），发现mPFC在道德决策中因果性地、情境依赖地整合情绪加工与价值评估，且这一机制存在性别差异：仅在女性被试中，抑制mPFC在低情绪卷入、高预期价值时降低功利主义倾向，在高情绪卷入、低预期价值时增加功利主义倾向。
AI.research_question: 内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）在道德决策中是否因果性地介导情绪加工与价值评估之间的动态转换？这一神经机制是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 先前研究已表明mPFC参与道德决策中的情绪加工和价值评估，但其因果性整合机制尚不清晰，且性别差异问题未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德决策的双加工理论（情绪加工 vs. 理性价值评估）、mPFC的情境依赖性功能假说
AI.method: 72名被试（36女，36男）完成涉及个人/非个人道德困境的决策任务，同时接受25分钟阴极或假性tDCS刺激mPFC，通过操纵结果大小（预期价值）来检验因果效应。
AI.findings: 阴极tDCS在低情绪卷入、高预期价值条件下降低功利主义倾向；在高情绪卷入、低预期价值条件下增加功利主义倾向。这些效应仅在女性被试中显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明mPFC对道德决策中情绪与价值信息的整合具有因果性、情境依赖性的作用；揭示了道德判断神经机制的性别差异，为双加工理论提供了更精细的脑机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同性别在道德判断中的差异提供神经基础；对神经调控技术在道德认知干预中的潜在应用具有启示意义。

title: Does Supply Chain Innovation Curb Corporate Greenwashing? Evidence from China
affiliations: Guangxi University, Guangxi University, Guangxi University and Yunnan University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Does Supply Chain Innovation Curb Corporate Greenwashing? Evidence from China
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of the green and low-carbon transition, corporate greenwashing has emerged as a major challenge for environmental governance, reflecting a gap between firms’ green claims and their actual environmental actions. Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed firms in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2013 to 2023, this study treats the Supply Chain Innovation and Application Pilot Policy launched in 2018 as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a continuous difference-in-differences approach to examine how supply chain innovation affects corporate greenwashing. The results show that supply chain innovation significantly curbs corporate greenwashing, and this finding remains robust across a series of robustness checks. Further analysis suggests that supply chain innovation curbs greenwashing mainly by improving information transparency, strengthening external monitoring, and enhancing firms’ sustained green innovation capability. The effect is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, capital-intensive firms, and firms whose executives have stronger green cognition. This study provides new empirical evidence on the formation and governance of corporate greenwashing from the perspective of digital supply chain governance, and offers useful implications for aligning supply chain innovation policies with firms’ green transformation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2013-2023年中国A股上市公司面板数据，以2018年供应链创新与应用试点政策为准自然实验，采用连续型双重差分法发现供应链创新能显著抑制企业漂绿行为，其机制在于提升信息透明度、加强外部监督和增强企业持续绿色创新能力，且在非国有企业、资本密集型企业和高管绿色认知较强的企业中效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 供应链创新如何影响企业漂绿行为？
AI.motivation: 在绿色低碳转型背景下，企业漂绿行为成为环境治理的重大挑战，但现有研究对供应链创新如何影响企业漂绿行为缺乏充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息透明度理论、外部监督理论、企业绿色创新理论
AI.method: 以2018年供应链创新与应用试点政策为准自然实验，采用连续型双重差分法（Continuous DID），使用2013-2023年中国沪深A股上市公司面板数据。
AI.findings: 供应链创新显著抑制企业漂绿行为；机制在于提升信息透明度、加强外部监督、增强企业持续绿色创新能力；在非国有企业、资本密集型企业和高管绿色认知较强的企业中效果更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 从数字供应链治理视角为企业漂绿行为的形成与治理提供了新的经验证据，丰富了供应链创新与企业环境行为关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链创新政策与企业绿色转型的协同提供了政策启示，有助于推动企业真实履行环保承诺而非仅进行象征性绿色宣传。

title: Responsible AI for Discretionary Spend Governance in Large Organizations: A Bounded, Assumption-Testing Framework with Human Authority

detail.title: Responsible AI for Discretionary Spend Governance in Large Organizations: A Bounded, Assumption-Testing Framework with Human Authority
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence enters enterprise spend governance, two questions matter for the Responsible AI community: where AI should operate, and how it should behave where it does. This paper presents a framework with four design pillars. Three-bounded application domain, preserved human authority, and full auditability-operationalize established Responsible AI principles for spend governance. The fourth is new: AI should test the assumptions behind a spend request, not the decision-maker who submitted it. The framework integrates with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems through three intelligence lenses-demand, rate, and specification-that surface stale assumptions in discretionary spend requests. Informed by anonymized enterprise deployments, the framework generalizes to any rule-bounded discretionary domain where AI must inform, but never replace, human judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于企业支出治理的负责任AI框架，包含四个设计支柱：有边界的应用领域、保留人类权威、完全可审计性，以及一个新的支柱——AI应测试支出请求背后的假设而非决策者本人。该框架通过三个智能透镜（需求、费率、规格）与ERP系统集成，可推广到任何规则约束的自由裁量领域。
AI.research_question: 在企业支出治理中，AI应该在哪些领域运作，以及在这些领域中应如何表现？
AI.motivation: 随着AI进入企业支出治理领域，负责任AI社区需要明确AI的运作边界和行为准则，以平衡效率提升与风险控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负责任AI原则（有边界的应用领域、保留人类权威、完全可审计性）；测试假设而非决策者的新设计支柱；三个智能透镜（需求、费率、规格）框架。
AI.method: 基于匿名化的企业部署经验，提出概念框架并与ERP系统集成。
AI.findings: 该框架能够识别自由裁量支出请求中过时的假设，并可推广到任何规则约束的自由裁量领域，其中AI必须为人类判断提供信息但绝不替代人类判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的设计支柱——AI应测试支出请求的假设而非决策者本人，丰富了负责任AI的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业支出治理提供了可操作的AI框架，通过三个智能透镜与ERP系统集成，能够识别过时假设并优化支出决策，同时确保人类权威和完全可审计性。

title: How Efficient is the Incubation Value Chain Model in Promoting Youth Agribusiness? Evidence from the Youth-Oriented Outreach Resource Training Centers in Eastern DR Congo
affiliations: International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, affiliation not provided to SSRN, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, Independent Researcher, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, affiliation not provided to SSRN and International Institute of Tropical Agriculture

detail.title: How Efficient is the Incubation Value Chain Model in Promoting Youth Agribusiness? Evidence from the Youth-Oriented Outreach Resource Training Centers in Eastern DR Congo
detail.abstract: Despite efforts to reduce youth unemployment through agribusiness incubations, significant gaps persist globally and in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) regarding the efficiency of the incubation value chain model in promoting youth in agribusiness. The study hypothesizes that incubation is most effective when aligning participants with value chains and fostering networks. It examines the effectiveness of the incubation value chain model through Youth-Oriented Outreach Resource Training Centers–Business Incubators (YORTC-BIs) in eastern DRC. It represents the first study conceptualizing YORTC-BIs as value chain architects rather than organizational structures. Using a sample of 310 youths, the study applies descriptive statistics and logistic regression to evaluate the determinants of youth participation in YORTC-BIs, while Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition assessed gender and spatial disparities. A quasi-experimental design combined with enterprise turnover growth analysis and propensity score matching assesses the impact of YORTC-BIs engagement in agribusiness and incubator efficiency compared to non-participants. Network analysis examines incubators’ interaction across value chain segments. Findings indicate that youth engagement in agribusiness is driven by training, assets, role models, and social networks, with gender and regional disparities. Participation in YORTC-BIs increases the likelihood of engagement by 56%, while incubated youth active across multiple value chain segments achieve 23% higher performance. Network analysis shows growing interconnections within the agribusiness system, with production as the central node. Value chain-oriented incubation models outperform standardized approaches, suggesting that context-sensitive, network-based strategies are essential for promoting inclusive agribusiness development and youth employment in fragile economic contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将YORTC-BIs概念化为价值链架构师而非组织结构，通过混合方法评估东刚果民主共和国青年导向的农业孵化模式。发现价值链导向的孵化模式优于标准化方法，参与孵化使青年从事农业综合企业的可能性提高56%，跨价值链环节孵化的青年绩效高出23%。
AI.research_question: 孵化价值链模型在促进刚果民主共和国东部青年参与农业综合企业方面的有效性如何？性别和空间差异如何影响参与效果？
AI.motivation: 尽管通过农业综合企业孵化努力减少青年失业，但全球和刚果民主共和国在孵化价值链模型促进青年参与农业企业的效率方面仍存在显著差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 孵化价值链模型理论：孵化应与价值链对齐并促进网络构建才能最有效；将YORTC-BIs概念化为价值链架构师而非传统组织结构。
AI.method: 310名青年样本；描述性统计与逻辑回归评估参与决定因素；Oaxaca-Blinder分解评估性别和空间差异；准实验设计结合企业营业额增长分析与倾向得分匹配评估影响；网络分析考察孵化器跨价值链环节的互动。
AI.findings: 青年从事农业企业受培训、资产、榜样和社会网络驱动，存在性别和区域差异；参与YORTC-BIs使从事农业可能性提高56%；跨价值链环节孵化的青年绩效高出23%；网络分析显示农业系统内互联性增强，生产是中心节点；价值链导向孵化模型优于标准化方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将YORTC-BIs概念化为价值链架构师而非组织结构；提出并验证了价值链导向孵化模型优于标准化方法的理论主张；揭示了网络互动在孵化效率中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为脆弱经济背景下促进包容性农业发展和青年就业提供了情境敏感、基于网络的战略建议；为刚果民主共和国及类似地区的青年农业孵化政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: Portfolio Choice with Competing Precautionary and Accumulation Goals
affiliations: Columbia University,  and Columbia University - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

detail.title: Portfolio Choice with Competing Precautionary and Accumulation Goals
detail.abstract: We study optimal portfolio choice for a household simultaneously managing a random-deadline goal, such as a medical emergency or job loss, and a fixed-deadline goal such as retirement or college tuition. Under a forced funding rule, in which each goal is paid in full whenever affordable, the household maximizes a weighted sum of the probabilities of fully funding both goals in a Black–Scholes market. We identify two novel effects absent from single-goal models: a growth crowding-out effect, in which precautionary saving for the random goal distorts investment toward the fixed goal, and a deadline pressure effect, in which a compressed saving horizon forces excess risk-taking. A striking implication is that the value function need not be monotone in wealth: a household just above the random-goal threshold is forced to pay it when the shock arrives, depleting its wealth for the fixed goal, and ends up worse off than a slightly poorer household that missed the random goal but kept its wealth intact. This non-monotonicity is absent from all single-goal benchmarks and arises purely from the interaction between the two goal types under forced funding. We further study an optional funding variant in which the household may decline the fixed-deadline goal at time T rather than being required to fund it. We characterize the ex ante option value, i.e., the full time-0 value of this flexibility and the terminal option value, i.e., its value at the funding decision node. We find that both options are most valuable at intermediate wealth levels where paying the fixed-deadline goal would substantially reduce the continuation value of the random-deadline problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了家庭在同时面临随机期限目标（如医疗紧急情况）和固定期限目标（如退休）时的最优投资组合选择，发现了增长挤出效应和期限压力效应两种新机制，并揭示了价值函数非单调性等反直觉结论。
AI.research_question: 在Black-Scholes市场环境下，家庭如何同时优化面向随机期限目标（如医疗紧急事件、失业）和固定期限目标（如退休、大学学费）的投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 现实中的家庭往往同时面临多种不同性质的财务目标，但现有模型大多只考虑单一目标（如只考虑退休储蓄），忽略了目标之间的交互作用。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Scholes市场模型、强制融资规则（forced funding rule）、加权概率最大化框架、实物期权理论。
AI.method: 通过构建包含两类目标的随机控制问题，在连续时间Black-Scholes框架下求解最优投资组合选择，并分析强制融资和可选融资两种情形。
AI.findings: 发现了两种新效应：1）增长挤出效应——为随机目标进行的预防性储蓄会扭曲投资向固定目标倾斜；2）期限压力效应——储蓄期限被压缩迫使投资者过度承担风险。关键发现：价值函数关于财富不一定是单调的——刚好超过随机目标阈值的家庭在冲击到来时被迫支付该目标，反而比略贫穷的家庭状况更差。这种非单调性纯由两类目标的交互作用产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多目标投资组合选择中独有的新效应（增长挤出效应、期限压力效应）和非单调价值函数特征，拓展了经典单目标投资组合理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭财务规划、退休储蓄与应急基金配置策略提供了理论指导，特别是在目标优先级权衡和风险管理方面。

title: Mathematical Foundations of the Circular Economy

detail.title: Mathematical Foundations of the Circular Economy
detail.abstract: We develop a competitive theory of circular economies. Commodities are indexed by physical material and quality state, so that residuals, recovered inputs, and virgin inputs are distinct economic objects. Feasibility requires material balance and residual routing: residual flows generated by households and firms must re-enter recovery rather than disappear through free disposal. Under convexity, bounded attainability, no-free-profit, and a circular Hawkins-Simon productiveness condition, a circular competitive equilibrium exists.
