AI.method: 提出CrashLex框架，包含：（1）双查询视觉-语言架构，通过并行语义流（Scene Queries）和符号流（Perception Queries）分别进行全局上下文建模和细粒度原子特征提取，以缓解目标幻觉；（2）领域特定法律知识图谱，将可观测物理条件映射为法定法律要素；（3）逻辑驱动聚合协议，基于验证事实和法律条文施加显式约束，确保推理过程完全可追溯和可解释。
AI.findings: 在DeepAccident数据集上，CrashLex实现94.0%的责任判定准确率，目标幻觉率降至2.8%，相比最佳MLLM基线降低了84%的幻觉率。模型将法律判断建立在确定性法律规则而非无约束的概率生成之上，产生满足司法可解释性要求的可审计推理链。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出神经符号驱动的法律推理范式，将视觉感知与法律知识图谱推理相结合，解决了MLLM在司法场景中目标幻觉与推理不可解释的难题，为AI与法律交叉领域提供了可审计、可验证的推理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能交通监控系统提供了法律级别的事故责任判定能力，显著降低人工干预和人为错误，有望推动自动驾驶责任认定、交通事故快速定责等实际应用场景的自动化与标准化。

title: Feature-Decoupled CNN-Boosting Ensemble for Robust Handwritten Digit Recognition: Accuracy, Generalization and Deployment Trade-offs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Dr. C. V, Raman University

detail.title: Feature-Decoupled CNN-Boosting Ensemble for Robust Handwritten Digit Recognition: Accuracy, Generalization and Deployment Trade-offs
detail.abstract: Handwritten digit recognition is also relevant to the digitization of documents, data capture in education, postal automation and financial record processing, but models that excel on normalized benchmarks might not be resilient to domain shift and computational constraints. The present study suggests a hybrid approach that combines a compact three-block CNN with exports of a 256-dimensional feature vector Dense1 to classifiers (AdaBoost, XGBoost and LightGBM) to obtain spatial representations from handwritten digit images. They make predictions using hard majority voting guided by the validation. The model was trained on the EMNIST Digits split which has 240,000 training images and 40,000 test images, using controlled augmentation with stratified validation and leakage-prevention rules. Evaluation was performed across classes, across the single classifiers, with component ablations, 10-fold cross validation, addition of synthetic noise, external-domain test sets (USPS and CEDAR), a perturbation test with the FGSM, and computational profiling. The overall performance with the accuracy of 98.45% and macro precision, recall and F1 score of 0.984 is 1.60% better than the standalone CNN. The accuracy drops to 98.20%, 97.95% and 97.80% when removing AdaBoost, XGBoost or LightGBM, respectively. The accuracy was kept at 97.82% when noise was Gaussian and 97.53% when noise was salt-and-pepper, but dropped to 94.80% on USPS and 90.20% on CEDAR. The ensemble achieved 85.30% accuracy while the CNN achieved 82.10% accuracy for the FGSM with ε = 0.1. The gains were obtained with 45 minutes of training, 150 ms/image CPU inference and 3.5 GB of memory. The contribution is then a characterization, guided by evidence, of when the CNN-to-boosting decoupling gives an edge to recognition and when it is hindered by costs of generalization and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合方法，将紧凑型三块CNN与三种提升模型（AdaBoost、XGBoost、LightGBM）集成，通过硬多数投票进行手写数字识别，在EMNIST数据集上达到98.45%的准确率，比单独CNN提升1.60%，并系统评估了该方法在不同噪声、跨域数据集和对抗攻击下的表现与局限。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种兼具高精度、鲁棒性和计算效率的手写数字识别方法，并系统评估CNN与boosting解耦集成在何时能带来优势、何时受到泛化与部署成本的制约？
AI.motivation: 手写数字识别在文档数字化、教育数据采集、邮政自动化和金融记录处理等领域有广泛应用，但现有模型在面对域偏移和计算资源约束时不够鲁棒，标准基准上的高表现不一定能迁移到实际场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: CNN特征提取与boosting集成学习的解耦；硬多数投票集成策略；域自适应与对抗鲁棒性理论。
AI.method: 采用三块紧凑型CNN提取256维特征向量（Dense1层），分别输入AdaBoost、XGBoost和LightGBM分类器，基于验证集性能进行硬多数投票集成。在EMNIST Digits上训练（24万训练/4万测试），使用受控数据增强、分层验证和防泄漏规则。评估包括各类别性能、单分类器比较、组件消融、10折交叉验证、合成噪声添加、外域测试集（USPS、CEDAR）、FGSM对抗攻击测试以及计算性能分析。
AI.findings: 整体准确率98.45%，宏精度/召回/F1均为0.984，比单独CNN高1.60%。去除AdaBoost、XGBoost、LightGBM后准确率分别降至98.20%、97.95%、97.80%。高斯噪声下97.82%，椒盐噪声下97.53%，USPS上降至94.80%，CEDAR上降至90.20%。FGSM（ε=0.1）下集成达85.30%，CNN仅82.10%。训练仅需45分钟，CPU推理150ms/张，内存3.5GB。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统刻画了CNN-to-boosting解耦集成在手写数字识别中何时能带来性能增益（高精度、抗噪、对抗鲁棒性），何时受制于域迁移和部署成本，为集成学习与深度学习结合提供了基于证据的理论边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个轻量级、可部署的混合识别方案，在计算资源有限的情况下（45分钟训练、低内存占用、CPU实时推理）实现高精度识别，并对实际场景中的噪声、域偏移和对抗攻击具有较好的鲁棒性，适合文档数字化、邮政自动化等实际应用。

title: Quantitative analysis of mineral oil contamination in flaxseed oil by Raman spectroscopy combined with the LSTM-SA model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Jilin University (JLU) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Quantitative analysis of mineral oil contamination in flaxseed oil by Raman spectroscopy combined with the LSTM-SA model

keywords.keywords: flaxseed oil、Mineral oil pollution 、Raman spectral analysis、Long short-term memory、Self-attention mechanism、Quantitative analysis

detail.abstract: During the transportation and storage of edible oil, it may be contaminated by mineral oil, which can have a serious impact on human health.However, due to the relatively low impurity content, quantitative detection is relatively difficult. This study proposes a new approach to quantitatively analyze mineral oil contamination in edible oil. Raman spectroscopy data of flaxseed oil samples contaminated by gasoline and lubricating oil were collected using Raman spectroscopy technology. Based on Raman spectroscopy, the LSTM-SA model was developed based on the self-attention mechanism (SA) and long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) for the rapid and accurate analysis of trace mineral oil impurities.The spectral data is feature selected through the competitive adaptive reweighted sampling (CARS) algorithm, and then input into the LSTM-SA model, thereby establishing a stable and accurate detection system. The experimental results show that the prediction effect of the LSTM-SA model is significantly better than that of partial least squares regression (PLSR), support vector regression (SVR) and kernel extreme learning machine(KELM). It effectively solves the problems of insufficient generalization ability and excessive prediction deviation of traditional regression models. Therefore, the LSTM-SA model combined with Raman spectroscopy has been proved to be an effective tool for edible oil safety detection. This method not only fully exploits the rapid and accurate identification capability of Raman spectroscopy, but also provides a new direction for future research on the non-destructive quality evaluation of food products.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合拉曼光谱与LSTM-SA（自注意力机制+长短期记忆神经网络）模型的方法，用于快速准确检测食用油中微量矿物油污染，实验表明该模型优于传统回归模型，为食品安全无损检测提供了新方向。
AI.research_question: 如何利用拉曼光谱技术结合深度学习模型，实现对食用油中微量矿物油污染的快速、准确定量检测？
AI.motivation: 食用油在运输和储存过程中可能被矿物油污染，对人体健康造成严重危害。由于杂质含量低，传统定量检测方法较为困难，亟需一种高灵敏度、高准确度的快速检测手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉曼光谱技术（提供分子指纹信息）；竞争自适应重加权采样（CARS）算法（特征选择）；长短期记忆神经网络（LSTM，捕捉序列依赖关系）；自注意力机制（SA，突出关键特征）。
AI.method: 1. 利用拉曼光谱技术采集被汽油和润滑油污染的亚麻籽油样品光谱数据；2. 通过CARS算法对光谱数据进行特征选择；3. 构建LSTM-SA模型进行定量分析；4. 与PLSR、SVR、KELM等传统模型进行对比。
AI.findings: LSTM-SA模型的预测效果显著优于PLSR、SVR和KELM等传统回归模型，有效解决了传统模型泛化能力不足和预测偏差过大的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自注意力机制与LSTM相结合应用于拉曼光谱分析领域，为微量污染物的光谱定量检测提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立了一种快速、准确、稳定的食用油矿物油污染检测系统，为食品安全无损质量评估提供了有效的技术手段和新方向。

title: A Note on Pollution Cleanup Investments, Signaling, Ganges River Resilience, and Lessons for Europe
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology

detail.title: A Note on Pollution Cleanup Investments, Signaling, Ganges River Resilience, and Lessons for Europe
detail.abstract: We study pollution cleanup investments, signaling, and the resilience of the Ganges river when investors differ in capability and cleanup projects differ in their ability to enhance resilience. First, we derive the minimal level of signaling necessary to sustain a separating equilibrium in which the government agency can distinguish between more and less capable investors. Larger cleanup efforts require greater signaling, although the marginal increase in signaling declines as the scale of cleanup expands. Second, we analyze the benchmark case in which signaling is impossible. Here, more and less capable investors choose the more resilience enhancing cleanup projects because the expected payment from these projects is larger than the payment from less resilience enhancing projects. Hence, eliminating signaling raises investor welfare and encourages projects that are more beneficial for the resilience of the Ganges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究恒河污染治理投资中，政府如何通过信号机制区分不同能力的投资者，以及信号成本对项目选择和恒河韧性的影响。研究发现，消除信号机制能促使投资者选择更有利于韧性提升的项目，并提高投资者福利。
AI.research_question: 在投资者能力异质、治理项目韧性提升效果不同的条件下，政府如何通过信号机制筛选投资者？信号成本如何影响项目选择和恒河生态韧性？
AI.motivation: 恒河污染治理面临投资者能力参差不齐的问题，政府需要设计机制区分高能力和低能力投资者，同时最大化污染治理对河流韧性的提升效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号博弈理论（Signaling Game）、分离均衡（Separating Equilibrium）、污染治理投资理论、生态韧性理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，比较存在信号机制与无信号机制两种情境下的投资者行为与福利效果。
AI.findings: （1）维持分离均衡需要一定水平的信号成本，且治理规模越大所需信号成本越高，但边际信号成本递减；（2）在无法信号的情况下，两类投资者均倾向于选择韧性提升效果更强的项目，因为预期收益更高；（3）消除信号机制能提升投资者福利，并引导更多有利于恒河韧性的治理项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号博弈理论应用于环境治理领域，揭示了信号成本与污染治理规模的非线性关系，并对比了有信号与无信号两种机制对投资决策和生态韧性的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府设计恒河污染治理的投资者筛选机制提供理论依据，建议简化信号要求以引导投资者选择更有利于生态韧性提升的治理项目，实现投资者福利与环境效益的双赢。

title: Hydroclimatic regime-informed LSTM generalization for improved streamflow prediction in tropical and subtropical catchments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Bristol, University of Bristol, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE) and Federal University of Pernambuco

detail.title: Hydroclimatic regime-informed LSTM generalization for improved streamflow prediction in tropical and subtropical catchments
detail.abstract: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks are being increasingly adopted for estimating river discharge due to their superior ability to capture long-term temporal dependencies. However, there is still a notable research gap in the literature associated with evaluating the generalization capacity of these deep learning models in tropical and subtropical ungauged catchments across diverse hydroclimatological regimes. We investigated the influence of system memory (lookback window), training spatial scales (regional vs. national), and hydroclimatic gradients on streamflow prediction over 200 catchments in Brazil with hydrological contrasting conditions. We used two LSTM training approaches: (i) Regional (regime-specific) and (ii) National, and the parsimonious lumped model GR4J as a benchmark. To evaluate the model's generalization capacity in unmeasured areas, 40 catchments were treated as entirely 'ungauged' and withheld from the training process. The results showed that the optimal lookback window is fundamentally governed by catchment storage dynamics. In humid regions, the model performance improved with increasing lookback (up to 120 days), reflecting the long-term dynamics related to groundwater processes. Conversely, arid catchments with crystalline substrate exhibited lookback independence due to rapid signal dissipation. Regionalized training consistently outperformed national composite frameworks by avoiding performance penalties associated with excessive data heterogeneity. Notably, regionally calibrated LSTMs proved highly competitive, matching or exceeding the performance of the conceptual GR4J model in 53.7% of the studied catchments. Evaluation in ungauged catchments revealed a stark climate-driven disparity. While robust predictive skill was achieved in humid environments (median KGE > 0.60), the stochasticity of semi arid regimes, characterized by flow intermittency and high evapotranspiration, remains a fundamental hurdle for purely inductive modeling. This study improves our understanding of deep learning memory mechanisms in tropical hydrology while providing key insights into the reliability of regionalized LSTMs for streamflow simulation. Our findings are valuable for water resource management and disaster planning in data-scarce regions, highlighting the need for physics-informed architectures to overcome predictability limits in highly variable hydrological systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究了LSTM网络在巴西200个热带亚热带流域径流预测中的泛化能力，发现最优回溯窗口受流域蓄水动态控制，区域化训练优于全国统一框架，LSTM在湿润区表现优异但在半干旱区面临随机性挑战。
AI.research_question: 在热带和亚热带未测流域中，LSTM模型的泛化能力如何受系统记忆（回溯窗口）、训练空间尺度（区域vs.全国）和水文气候梯度的影响？
AI.motivation: LSTM网络在径流估算中应用日益广泛，但针对热带和亚热带未测流域在不同水文气候条件下的泛化能力评估仍存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: LSTM深度学习的时间依赖机制、流域蓄水动态理论、区域化水文建模方法。
AI.method: 在巴西200个水文条件对比鲜明的流域中，采用两种LSTM训练方法（区域/全国），以GR4J作为基准模型，将40个流域完全视为"未测"以评估泛化能力。
AI.findings: (1) 最优回溯窗口由流域蓄水动态决定：湿润区随回溯窗口增加性能提升（最多120天），干旱结晶基底流域表现为回溯窗口独立；(2) 区域化训练始终优于全国统一框架；(3) 区域LSTM在53.7%流域达到或超过GR4J；(4) 未测流域存在气候驱动差异：湿润区预测稳健（KGE>0.60），半干旱区随机性仍是根本挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对热带水文领域中深度学习记忆机制的理解，揭示了回溯窗口与流域蓄水动态之间的理论关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据稀缺地区的水资源管理和灾害规划提供了区域化LSTM用于径流模拟的可靠性见解，指出了需要物理信息架构来克服高变异性水文系统的可预测性极限。

title: The Economics of Religious Regulation: An Austrian Contribution
affiliations: Texas Tech University - Free Market Institute and

detail.title: The Economics of Religious Regulation: An Austrian Contribution
detail.abstract: The economics of religion is a growing subfield, yet no paper has connected its findings to Austrian economics. Three Austrian insights are complementary with the current literature and provide a unified theoretical framework for understanding the relationship between religion and religious regulation, meaning attempts at hierarchical religious control by the state. First, government interventions and regulation of religious communities entail the same knowledge problems that beleaguer regulation of markets. Second, Austrian market process theory explains how religious club goods adapt to government interventions. Third, Austrian dynamics of interventionism explain why religious regulations rarely achieve planners' intended outcome. We conclude with future avenues of research that pair Austrian insights with the current economics of religion literature.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将奥地利学派经济学与宗教经济学联系起来，运用奥地利学派的三个核心洞见（知识问题、市场过程理论、干预主义动态）构建统一理论框架，解释宗教监管如何影响宗教活动及其意外后果。
AI.research_question: 奥地利学派经济学如何为理解宗教与宗教监管之间的关系提供统一的理论框架？
AI.motivation: 宗教经济学虽是日益增长的子领域，但尚未有论文将其发现与奥地利学派经济学联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥地利学派经济学的三大洞见：1) 政府干预宗教社区面临与市场干预相同的知识问题；2) 奥地利市场过程理论解释宗教俱乐部商品如何适应政府干预；3) 奥地利干预主义动态理论解释为何宗教监管很少达到计划者的预期目标。
AI.method: 理论整合与文献综述
AI.findings: 奥地利学派经济学的三个核心洞见与现有宗教经济学文献互补，为理解宗教与宗教监管之间的关系提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将奥地利学派经济学与宗教经济学相结合，为宗教监管研究提供了基于知识问题、市场过程和干预主义动态的统一理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解宗教监管的意外后果提供了分析工具，提示宗教监管可能导致类似市场干预的未预期结果。

title: The Effects of Human Capital on the Extensive Margin of Female Labour Supply: Evidence from Malawi
affiliations: Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources and Lilongwe University of Agriculture and Natural Resources

detail.title: The Effects of Human Capital on the Extensive Margin of Female Labour Supply: Evidence from Malawi

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No potential conflict of interest was reported by the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no funding for this study.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the effects of human capital on the extensive margin of female labour supply within the framework of the standard theoretical model of labour supply. Our analysis uses pooled crosssectional data from the Malawi 2010-2019 Integrated Household Panel Survey and relies primarily on Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) technique and instrumental variables (IV) approach to estimate the causal effect of human capital on labour supply and to correct for endogeneity of education. Our results confirm the relevance of human capital, as embodied in education and labour market experience in determining women's labour supply in Malawi. Findings from the labour force participation model show that participation generally increases with educational attainment; however, this trend is significantly interrupted by a decline at first-degree level, followed by pronounced improvement at postgraduate level, suggesting a possible frustration or status effects among first-degree holders attributed to unattained expectations in labour markets with a dominant informal sector. Our analysis also reveals weak effect of primary and junior secondary education in influencing women's participation, demonstrating that primary and junior secondary school may be relevant for home production and only higher secondary school and tertiary education are significant in creating labour market opportunities. The study also finds a positive relationship between women's labour force participation and labour market experience up to about 36 years of labour market experience; thereafter, participation is negatively associated with experience. The findings also reveal a striking diminishing complementarity between schooling and labour market experience suggesting that for women with low labour market experience, schooling may have a strong positive effect on participation. However, as experience increases, the marginal benefits of education slightly diminish. In addition, the interaction of education and the number of children for women is negative and highly significant, indicating that the positive effect of education on women's labour force participation weakens as the number of children increases.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用马拉维2010-2019年面板数据，分析人力资本对女性劳动供给广泛边际的影响，发现教育程度与劳动参与率呈非线性关系（学士学位出现下降），且工作经验、子女数量等调节效应显著。
AI.research_question: 人力资本如何影响女性劳动供给的广泛边际（劳动参与决策）？
AI.motivation: 在撒哈拉以南非洲（如马拉维）以非正规部门为主的劳动力市场中，教育对女性劳动参与的影响尚不明晰，尤其是高等教育可能产生的"挫折效应"或"地位效应"未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准劳动供给理论模型，涵盖人力资本理论（教育、工作经验）、劳动参与决策的广泛边际分析，以及教育与家庭特征（如子女数量）的交互效应。
AI.method: 使用马拉维2010-2019年综合家庭面板调查（IHPS）的混合截面数据，采用最大似然估计（MLE）和工具变量法（IV）处理教育的内生性。
AI.findings: (1) 劳动参与率随教育程度提高而上升，但学士学位阶段出现显著下降（博士学位恢复上升）；(2) 小学和初中教育对参与率影响微弱，高中及高等教育才显著；(3) 工作经验与参与率呈倒U型关系（约36年达到峰值）；(4) 教育与工作经验存在递减互补性；(5) 教育对参与率的正效应随子女数量增加而减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在非正规部门主导的发展中国家，人力资本对女性劳动供给存在非线性效应（学士学位"挫折效应"），以及教育-经验互补性递减的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家教育政策与女性就业促进提供启示：基础教育需与劳动力市场需求匹配，高等教育需关注就业期望落差问题，同时应考虑家庭照料负担对教育回报的削弱作用。

title: Adaptive subsidy implementation for stakeholder-centric biofuel supply chains
affiliations: University of Sheffield, University of Sheffield and University of Sheffield - Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

detail.title: Adaptive subsidy implementation for stakeholder-centric biofuel supply chains
detail.abstract: The transition to sustainable energy is hindered by the uncertain dynamics of biofuel supply chains, where traditional subsidy schemes often create inefficiencies, unintended consequences, and misaligned incentives that undermine sustainability goals. This work proposes a framework to formulate and implement adaptive subsidy plans for biofuel supply chains by highlighting the critical role of stakeholder engagement throughout the biofuel ecosystem. We introduce an agent-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that describes stakeholder dynamics and adaptively explores subsidy policies. Our framework simulates multi-agent interactions across the biofuel value chain, enabling the system to learn adaptive subsidy policies that respond to evolving and uncertain stakeholder behaviours. Computational experiments demonstrate that the RL-based approach can identify subsidy designs that improve efficiency while reducing the risk of misaligned incentives, thereby enhancing long-term ecosystem resilience. By providing a robust mechanism for exploring policy alternatives, we reveal the emergent coordination patterns that unlock the full potential of biofuel supply chains, ensuring that public investment translates into scalable, equitable, and environmentally robust outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应补贴框架，用于优化生物燃料供应链中的补贴政策，以应对传统补贴方案的低效和激励错位问题。通过多智能体仿真，该框架能够学习适应性补贴策略，提高效率、降低风险，并增强生态系统的长期韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和实施自适应补贴方案，以优化生物燃料供应链中多方利益相关者的动态互动，提升效率并实现可持续能源转型目标？
AI.motivation: 传统补贴方案在生物燃料供应链中存在效率低下、意外后果和激励错位等问题，阻碍了可持续能源转型。现有方法缺乏对利益相关者复杂动态行为的建模能力，亟需一种能够自适应调整补贴策略的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能体的强化学习（Agent-based Reinforcement Learning）框架；多智能体交互理论；自适应政策设计理论。
AI.method: 构建基于智能体的强化学习框架，模拟生物燃料价值链中的多智能体交互，通过强化学习自适应探索补贴政策，并在计算实验中评估其表现。
AI.findings: 基于强化学习的方法能够识别出提升效率、降低激励错位风险的补贴设计方案；增强了长期生态系统韧性；揭示了能够释放生物燃料供应链潜力的涌现协调模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将强化学习引入生物燃料供应链政策设计领域，提出了自适应补贴的理论框架；揭示了多智能体互动中涌现的协调模式对政策效果的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种可操作的、数据驱动的自适应补贴设计工具；有助于确保公共投资转化为可扩展、公平且环境可持续的能源成果；提高了补贴政策的精准性和灵活性。

title: Microplastics in a Malaysian tropical estuary: source characterization, mid-estuarine accumulation, and monsoon transport
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Microplastics in a Malaysian tropical estuary: source characterization, mid-estuarine accumulation, and monsoon transport
detail.abstract: Tropical estuaries are among the most under-sampled aquatic systems in the global microplastic literature, despite their role as transition zones for land-derived debris. We sampled 20 stations along the river–estuary continuum of Sungai Merbok, a mangrove-fringed estuary in Peninsular Malaysia, in May, July, September, and November 2024 (n = 80 surface-water samples). A 330 µm manta trawl filtered a mean of 17.07 ± 3.21 m³ per sample. We enumerated 1,971 microplastic particles in total (mean 1.46 ± 2.28 particles/m³, range 0.05–18.21) detected in every sample. Five mid-estuarine stations (SM 9, 11, 12, 14, 15) held 54.7% of all particles, and September concentrations ran 1.7 times higher than May and July combined. Of 547 particles analysed by FTIR, polyethylene (49.9%) and polypropylene (17.6%) together accounted for two-thirds of identified polymers, pointing to consumer packaging as the principal source. Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) was the third most abundant polymer at 10.8%, well above the 0–2% typically reported for estuarine surface waters and raises the prospect of co-occurring PFAS contamination. Fragments dominated the morphological composition (66.8%), suggesting secondary breakdown of larger plastic items. Among environmental parameters, pH was the strongest single correlate of microplastic concentration (rs = -0.39, p < 0.001), followed by dissolved oxygen and salinity. A multiple regression model with five environmental predictors explained only 22% of log-concentration variance, showing that hydrodynamic processes drive spatial distribution rather than static water quality. These findings highlight two management priorities: extended producer responsibility for PE/PP packaging and pre-monsoon cleanups at mid-estuarine hotspots.

AI.tldr: 本研究对马来西亚槟城州Sungai Merbok热带河口的80个表层水样进行微塑料分析，发现所有样本均含有微塑料（平均1.46 ± 2.28颗粒/m³），聚乙烯和聚丙烯占总聚合物的三分之二，且聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）占比异常高（10.8%），提示可能存在PFAS共污染。碎片形态占主导（66.8%），pH是微塑料浓度最强的单因素相关性指标。
AI.research_question: 热带河口——作为陆地来源垃圾的过渡带——的微塑料污染水平、空间分布、聚合物组成及环境驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 热带河口是全球微塑料文献中采样最不足的水生系统之一，而它们作为陆地碎屑的过渡带具有重要意义，因此亟需填补这一知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微塑料的源-汇理论、河口过渡带的输运与滞留机制、聚合物类型与来源的关联分析。
AI.method: 2024年5月、7月、9月、11月在Sungai Merbok河口的20个站点采集80个表层水样（330 µm manta拖网），使用FTIR分析547个颗粒的聚合物成分，结合环境参数进行相关性分析与多元回归建模。
AI.findings: 1) 共检出1,971个微塑料颗粒，平均1.46 ± 2.28颗粒/m³，所有样本均检出微塑料；2) 5个中河口站点占54.7%的颗粒，9月浓度是5月和7月合计的1.7倍；3) PE（49.9%）和PP（17.6%）占聚合物三分之二，PTFE占10.8%（异常高）；4) 碎片占66.8%；5) pH是最强单因素相关变量（rs = -0.39, p < 0.001）；6) 五变量回归模型仅解释22%的方差，提示水动力过程主导分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了热带河口微塑料污染的独特特征：PTFE异常高占比（提示PFAS共污染风险），以及水动力因素而非静态水质主导空间分布的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出对PE/PP包装实施延伸生产者责任；2) 建议在季风前对中河口热点区域进行清理行动。

title: CausalPol: Extracting and Validating Causal Claims in Policy Documents Using Large Language Models
affiliations: Baylor University

detail.title: CausalPol: Extracting and Validating Causal Claims in Policy Documents Using Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Policy documents-legislation, regulatory impact assessments, central bank communications, and international agreement texts-are dense with causal claims that embed and justify consequential decisions about resource allocation, market regulation, and public welfare. These claims rarely announce themselves as such: causal reasoning in policy text is embedded in passive constructions, nominalized verb phrases, hedged conditionals, and domain-specific terminology that defeats general-purpose information extraction systems. We introduce CausalPol, a system for extracting and validating causal claims from multilingual policy documents, built on a taxonomy of causal language derived from a corpus study of 23,400 policy documents across seven policy domains and six languages. CausalPol combines a fine-tuned extraction model for causal span identification with an LLM-based validation pipeline that assesses claim plausibility against domain knowledge, identifies logical inconsistencies between co-occurring claims, and flags claims whose empirical basis is contested in the scientific literature. We construct PolCausal-50K, a benchmark corpus of 50,247 policy document paragraphs with expert annotations of causal spans, causal type (mechanism vs. correlation vs. definitional), epistemic status (established vs. contested vs. speculative), and domain. On span-level causal extraction, CausalPol achieves F1 = 0.79 across domains (vs. 0.71 for prior best on comparable data), with particular gains in legislative text (+11.3 points) and central bank communications (+8.7 points). On claim validation, LLM-based plausibility assessment achieves k = 0.68 agreement with domain expert panels, and the cross-claim inconsistency detector identifies conflicting causal claims within the same document at a rate of 6.3% in EU regulatory impact assessments—a finding with direct practical implications for evidence quality in policymaking. We release PolCausal-50K and CausalPol under open licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalPol系统，用于从多语言政策文档中提取和验证因果声明。系统结合微调抽取模型和基于LLM的验证管道，在包含50,247段标注语料的基准上，跨度级因果抽取F1达0.79，较此前最优提升显著。研究还发现欧盟监管影响评估中6.3%的文档存在冲突因果声明，对政策制定中的证据质量有直接实践意义。
AI.research_question: 如何从多语言政策文档中自动提取和验证蕴含其中的因果声明？
AI.motivation: 政策文档中充斥着影响资源分配、市场监管和公共福利的关键因果主张，但这些主张往往隐藏在被动语态、名词化动词短语、条件句和领域术语中，通用信息提取系统难以有效识别，亟需专门化的因果提取与验证方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果语言分类学（基于23,400份政策文档的语料库研究），涵盖因果跨度识别、因果类型（机制/相关/定义性）、认知状态（已确立/有争议/推测性）等维度。
AI.method: CausalPol系统由两部分组成：(1) 微调的因果跨度抽取模型；(2) 基于LLM的验证管道，包括面向领域知识的声明合理性评估、共现声明的逻辑不一致检测、以及对照科学文献识别实证基础受争议的声明。同时构建了带专家标注的PolCausal-50K基准语料库。
AI.findings: (1) 因果跨度抽取F1=0.79，跨域表现优于此前最优（0.71），在法律文本（+11.3点）和央行沟通（+8.7点）中提升显著；(2) LLM合理性评估与专家小组一致性k=0.68；(3) 欧盟监管影响评估中6.3%的文档存在冲突因果声明。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于大规模多语言多领域政策语料库的因果语言分类学，为政策文本中的因果推理分析提供了系统化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供CausalPol系统和PolCausal-50K开源基准，可用于自动分析政策文档中的因果推理质量；(2) 检测到欧盟监管影响评估中相当比例的冲突因果声明，为政策制定中的证据评估提供了实用工具和警示。

title: Good Rules, Unusable Streets: A Typology of Implementation Failure in Urban Mobility Policy in Türkiye
affiliations: Turkish National Police Academy and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Good Rules, Unusable Streets: A Typology of Implementation Failure in Urban Mobility Policy in Türkiye
detail.abstract: Urban transport policy in Türkiye presents a persistent paradox: regulatory frameworks that are comprehensive and internationally comparable coexist with built environments that systematically fail to deliver their intended outcomes. This article examines why well-designed policy frameworks do not translate into functional urban spaces, using two cases — accessibility for persons with disabilities and bicycle transportation — as empirical ground.,The study employs a comparative case study design, analyzing each case across three layers: the de jure normative environment, the de facto physical and operational conditions, and the mechanisms sustaining the distance between them. Data are drawn on secondary empirical evidence from GIS-based field studies, monitoring reports, national institutional assessments, and official planning documents covering multiple Turkish cities.,The findings document a consistent pattern of implementation failure across both cases. In accessibility, ramps are absent or non-functional in 75% of required locations; accessibility criteria are unmet in over half of monitored public spaces; and transport chain continuity remains structurally broken. In cycling, 46% of metropolitan municipalities have less than 25 km of bicycle infrastructure; existing lanes are frequently interrupted or encroached upon by motorized traffic.,Drawing on institutional decoupling theory, the article argues that the gap can be understood as a functional equilibrium: high normative standards provide legitimacy at low political cost, while full implementation — spatially and institutionally costly — is systematically deferred. A four-type typology is proposed — symbolic compliance, discontinuous infrastructure, occupied space, and institutional fragmentation — to distinguish the mechanisms through which failure is reproduced. The typology offers both descriptive precision and a basis for targeted policy intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文基于制度脱耦理论，以土耳其的无障碍通行和自行车交通两个案例，揭示了政策法规完善但实施全面失败的悖论，并提出四种失败机制的类型学。
AI.research_question: 为什么设计良好的政策框架无法转化为功能性的城市空间？政策与实践之间的鸿沟如何持续存在？
AI.motivation: 土耳其城市交通政策存在显著悖论：法规框架完备且与国际接轨，但城市建成环境却系统性失效。作者希望解释这一"政策-实践"脱节现象的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度脱耦理论（Institutional Decoupling Theory），即组织/制度在形式上采纳规范以获取合法性，但实际执行与规范脱节。
AI.method: 比较案例研究设计，从三个层面（法律规范环境、实际物理与运营条件、维系两者差距的机制）分析两个案例，数据来源于GIS实地调研、监测报告、国家机构评估和官方规划文件等二手实证证据。
AI.findings: （1）无障碍方面：75%的坡道缺失或无法使用，超半数公共空间不达标，交通链连续性断裂；（2）自行车方面：46%的大都市自行车基础设施不足25公里，现有车道频繁被机动车交通中断或侵占。整体呈现系统性实施失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度脱耦理论应用于城市交通政策领域，提出四种失败机制的类型学：象征性合规、不连续基础设施、空间被占用、制度碎片化，为描述实施失败提供了精确的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的四类型学可为针对性政策干预提供基础，帮助政策制定者识别和打破"高规范-低执行"的功能性均衡。

title: Reinforcing The Indigenous Citizens Ownership of the Medium and Large-Scale Mining Companies in Malawi Through Listing on The Malawi Stock Exchange Supported by Donor-Funded Credit Lines
affiliations: Blantyre International University - Accounting and Finance Department

detail.title: Reinforcing The Indigenous Citizens Ownership of the Medium and Large-Scale Mining Companies in Malawi Through Listing on The Malawi Stock Exchange Supported by Donor-Funded Credit Lines
detail.abstract: Medium and large-scale mining is geared to increase Malawi's exports, earning over USD2 billion annually by 2030 and expected to earn USD43 billion by 2040. There are however genuine fears that the benefits will not cascade down to the local citizens as there is currently no local ownership save for free equity owned by the Government of Malawi in line with Section 260 of the Mines and Minerals Act 2023. The local investors tried to persuade the Government to list the mining companies on the local bourse and the same is part of the mining development agreements. It is however obvious that local investors cannot mobilise enough resources unless the donors can provide support as they did in the 1990s.

AI.tldr: 马拉维大规模采矿虽预期带来巨额外汇收入，但当地投资者缺乏资金、无法实现本地持股，除非获得捐助者支持。
AI.research_question: 马拉维中大规模采矿的收益如何惠及本地投资者？本地持股面临哪些障碍？
AI.motivation: 马拉维采矿预计带来大量外汇收入，但缺乏本地股权参与，收益难以惠及当地民众。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒理论、本地股权参与、发展金融
AI.method: 基于《2023年矿业和矿产法》及相关矿业发展协议的政策分析与案例研究
AI.findings: 马拉维政府持有免费股权，但本地投资者无法筹集足够资源；尽管矿业发展协议要求本地上市，但缺乏捐助者支持难以实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在资源丰富的发展中国家，仅靠政策规定无法解决本地资本筹措的结构性障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议捐助者提供金融支持以促进本地投资者参与矿业股权，确保采矿收益惠及当地民众。

title: Long Story Short: Omitted Variable Bias in Causal Machine Learning
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of Washington - Department of Statistics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Microsoft Research Lab and Microsoft Research

detail.title: Long Story Short: Omitted Variable Bias in Causal Machine Learning

declarations.funderStatement: This research was partially funded by the Royalty Research Fund at the University of Washington and by the National Science Foundation under Grants No. MMS-2417955 and 2242447.

detail.abstract: We develop a general theory of omitted variable bias for a wide range of common causal parameters, including (but not limited to) averages of potential outcomes, average treatment effects, average causal derivatives, and policy effects from covariate shifts. Our theory applies to nonparametric models, while naturally allowing for (semi-)parametric restrictions (such as partial linearity) when such assumptions are made. We show how simple plausibility judgments on the maximum explanatory power of omitted variables are sufficient to bound the magnitude of the bias, thus facilitating sensitivity analysis in otherwise complex, nonlinear models. Finally, we provide flexible and efficient statistical inference methods, which can leverage modern machine learning algorithms for estimation. These results allow empirical researchers to perform sensitivity analyses in a flexible class of machine-learned causal models using very simple, and interpretable, tools. Empirical examples demonstrate the utility of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于广泛因果参数的遗漏变量偏差通用理论，涵盖非参数模型及半参数情形，通过遗漏变量最大解释力度的简单合理性判断来约束偏差幅度，并提供了可结合机器学习的高效统计推断方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在包含复杂非线性模型和机器学习估计的因果推断中，对遗漏变量偏差进行敏感性分析？
AI.motivation: 现有的遗漏变量偏差理论多局限于线性模型或特定因果参数，缺乏适用于现代机器学习因果模型和非线性设置的通用敏感性分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遗漏变量偏差的一般理论；非参数因果模型；基于最大解释力度的偏差边界
AI.method: 发展通用理论推导不同因果参数（如平均处理效应、因果导数、策略效应）的遗漏变量偏差表达式；利用简单合理性判断（如R²最大值）来约束偏差；结合机器学习算法进行高效估计与推断。
AI.findings: 简单的遗漏变量解释力度判断（如最大R²）足以对复杂非线性模型中的遗漏变量偏差进行有意义的边界约束；所提出的统计推断方法高效且灵活，可用于机器学习因果模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将遗漏变量偏差理论从线性模型推广到非参数和半参数模型；统一处理了多种常见因果参数的偏差形式；建立了偏差边界与解释力度之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用机器学习进行因果推断的实证研究者提供了简单、可解释的敏感性分析工具；使得在复杂非线性模型中进行遗漏变量偏差评估变得可行。

title: Vocational Interests in Education, Employment and Assessment: A Program of Australian Research
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Vocational Interests in Education, Employment and Assessment: A Program of Australian Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no competing interest and the author has no financial disclosure.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study involved ta review of hte literature and satisfied ethics committee exemption criteria.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This monograph reviews a sustained program of empirical and theoretical research on vocational interests conducted in Australian contexts over more than four decades (1980–2022). Drawing together approximately 25 published papers and reports spanning six thematic areas, it examines the role of vocational interest in learning and educational achievement, employment and career pathways, the measurement of interests, the validity of self-estimates, the dimensional structure of interest space and developmental and population-level perspectives.

Six interrelated research questions organise the program: (1) How does vocational interest relate to educational achievement and domain learning? (2) To what extent does interest predict and shape outcomes in employment and career development? (3) What are the most valid and defensible methods for assessing vocational interests? (4) Can individuals accurately estimate their own interests without formal psychometric instruments? (5) What is the dimensional structure of vocational interests in Australian samples and how well does it conform to Holland’s hexagonal model? (6) How do vocational interests develop across the life course and how are they distributed across the Australian occupational structure?

The program yields a coherent set of answers: interest is a powerful predictor of individual educational achievement, consistently outperforming instructional quality; its relationship with employment outcomes is real but substantially constrained by labour market structures that systematically misalign with the distribution of individual preferences; direct and ipsative assessment methods are both psychometrically defensible and practically superior to conventional inventoried approaches; self-estimates of interests possess genuine convergent validity; the underlying dimensional structure conforms to Prediger’s people-versus-things and data-versus-ideas model; and the differentiation of interest profiles is a developmental achievement emerging across childhood and adolescence. Taken together, the findings argue for an empirically grounded reconceptualisation of interest in Australian career guidance practice.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了澳大利亚四十余年（1980–2022）关于职业兴趣的实证与理论研究项目，整合约25篇论文，涵盖六大主题。研究发现：兴趣是教育成就的强预测因子（优于教学质量）；兴趣与就业结果的关系受劳动力市场结构约束；直接与自比测量法优于传统问卷；兴趣自评具有收敛效度；维度结构符合Prediger的人-物与数据-观念模型；兴趣分化是童年至青春期的发育成就。这些发现为澳大利亚职业指导实践中的兴趣概念提供了以实证为基础的重构。
AI.research_question: 六个研究问题：（1）职业兴趣如何影响教育成就与领域学习？（2）兴趣在多大程度上预测和塑造就业与职业发展结果？（3）评估职业兴趣最有效且可辩护的方法是什么？（4）个体能否在没有正式心理测量工具的情况下准确估计自己的兴趣？（5）澳大利亚样本中职业兴趣的维度结构如何，是否符合Holland的六边形模型？（6）职业兴趣如何在整个生命历程中发展，如何在澳大利亚职业结构中分布？
AI.motivation: 尽管职业兴趣在心理学和职业教育领域具有重要地位，但其在澳大利亚背景下的系统性、长期性实证研究相对分散。作者旨在通过整合四十余年的研究项目，提供关于职业兴趣在教育、就业、测量方法、结构与发展等方面的连贯性答案，并为澳大利亚职业指导实践提供经验基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: Holland的职业兴趣六边形模型；Prediger的人-物与数据-观念维度模型；兴趣发展与分化理论；劳动力市场匹配理论。
AI.method: 综述性研究，整合约25篇已发表论文和报告，涵盖六个主题领域的数据收集与分析（包括实证研究与理论分析）。
AI.findings: （1）兴趣是教育成就的强预测因子，优于教学质量；（2）兴趣与就业结果相关，但受劳动力市场结构严重约束，供需存在系统性错配；（3）直接测量与自比测量法在心理测量学上可靠且实用，优于传统问卷；（4）兴趣自评具有真实的收敛效度；（5）维度结构符合Prediger模型（人物 vs. 事物；数据 vs. 观念）；（6）兴趣分化是童年至青春期的发展成就。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持并修正了Holland六边形模型在澳大利亚情境下的适用性，提出了Prediger双维度模型作为更优的结构框架；将兴趣发展视为一个分化的发育成就，丰富了兴趣发展理论；揭示了劳动力市场结构对兴趣-结果关系的调节作用，补充了匹配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为澳大利亚职业指导实践提供了以实证为基础的兴趣概念重构；推荐直接测量与自比测量作为优于传统问卷的评估方法；建议政策制定者和教育工作者重视兴趣作为超越教学质量的预测因子；提醒职业咨询师注意劳动力市场结构对兴趣-就业匹配的约束。

title: More Crime, More Guns?
affiliations: and University of Central Missouri - Economics & Finance

detail.title: More Crime, More Guns?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Although self-defense is the most commonly cited reason for gun purchases, there is little causal evidence that gun demand responds to changes in crime rates. We study the effect of crime on gun demand in three ways. First, we examine large, persistent changes in crime stemming from 2009 police hiring grants in U.S. cities. We use grant receipt as an instrument to estimate the effect of crime on firearm demand, employing three different measures of local gun demand. Across all measures, we find no evidence that crime affects firearm demand. Second, we analyze the effects of massive, short-run spikes in local crime. Specifically, we identify crime shocks over two-week intervals for Massachusetts towns. Using detailed data on gun sales and concealed-carry weapon (CCW) permits, we find that gun purchases increase following a local crime spike. However, these spikes are extremely rare and the effects are modest, with an implied elasticity of gun sales with respect to crime ranging from 0.1 to 0.26. CCW permit applications do not respond, possibly because obtaining a permit requires additional steps. Third, we consider how firearm demand responds to shocks that increase fears of future gun control. County-level responses in demand are primarily related to political partisanship and are uncorrelated with local crime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三种实证方法研究犯罪率对枪支需求的影响，发现犯罪率变化对枪支需求的总体影响很小，而政治因素（如对枪支管控的担忧）才是驱动枪支需求的主要因素。
AI.research_question: 犯罪率变化是否以及如何影响枪支需求？
AI.motivation: 尽管"自卫"是购买枪支最常被引用的理由，但缺乏因果证据表明枪支需求会对犯罪率变化做出响应。作者希望填补这一因果识别的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性选择理论（个体根据犯罪风险进行自我保护决策）和预防性动机理论（枪支作为应对犯罪威胁的预防手段）。
AI.method: 三种实证方法：1）利用2009年警察招聘拨款作为工具变量，估计犯罪率对枪支需求的影响；2）利用马萨诸塞州两周间隔的犯罪冲击面板数据，分析短期犯罪飙升对枪支销售和隐蔽持枪证申请的影响；3）分析未来枪支管控担忧（政治因素）对枪支需求的影响。
AI.findings: 1）长期持续性犯罪率变化对枪支需求无显著影响；2）短期犯罪冲击后枪支购买小幅增加（弹性0.1-0.26），但此类冲击极为罕见，且对隐蔽持枪证申请无影响；3）枪支需求对枪支管控担忧的反应主要受政治党派倾向驱动，与地方犯罪率无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供因果证据表明犯罪率对枪支需求的影响极为有限，挑战了"自卫动机驱动枪支购买"的常识性假设，并揭示政治因素（枪支管控担忧）才是更重要的驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为枪支管控政策制定提供实证依据：减少犯罪本身未必能抑制枪支需求，需关注政治极化和公众对枪支管控政策的预期；对警方资源配置和公共安全策略有参考意义。

title: Monetary Policy and Oil-Shock Pass-Through: Evidence from Morocco, 2020-2025
affiliations: and Ecole Nationale de Commerce et de Gestion (ENCG) Kénitra

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Oil-Shock Pass-Through: Evidence from Morocco, 2020-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available aggregate macroeconomic data and does not involve human subjects, patients, or personally identifiable information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Morocco imports the entirety of its refined petroleum products since the SAMIR refinery closed in 2015. When Brent crude prices tripled between April 2020 and June 2022, Moroccan consumer-price inflation reached 10.1 percent year-on-year in February 2023 (the highest level in three decades) and Bank Al-Maghrib (BAM) raised its policy rate from 1.50% to 3.00% between September 2022 and March 2023. The central question this paper addresses is whether that monetary tightening was associated with a smaller pass-through of oil-price shocks to domestic inflation, and if so, at what horizons. The empirical strategy estimates state-dependent Local Projections (Jordà, 2005) on monthly data from January 2020 to June 2025, distinguishing between a tight monetary regime (September 2022-June 2024) and a loose regime covering the rest of the sample. The tight-regime interaction coefficient γ h is negative at 12 of 13 horizons, reaching-10.2 percentage points at h = 8 months. Under loose policy, a 100% Brent price increase raises year-on-year CPI by 1.6-2.0 pp at h = 2-3 months, comparable to international benchmarks. A joint test rejects H 0 : γ h = 0 for all h (sign-test p < 0.001; Wald χ 2 13 = 25.8, p = 0.018). Five robustness exercises confirm the directional finding. Mechanism analysis localises the effect in the energy and transport CPI sub-components rather than at the import border. The findings are consistent with Tenreyro and Thwaites (2016)'s characterisation of statedependent monetary transmission, with caveats about fiscal-compensation policies operating concurrently during the tight regime.

AI.tldr: 本文利用摩洛哥2020年1月至2025年6月的数据，通过状态依赖的局部投影法，检验了2022-2023年货币紧缩政策是否降低了石油价格冲击对国内通胀的传导效应。研究发现，在紧缩货币政策下，油价冲击对CPI的传导显著减弱，最大效应出现在冲击后8个月，传导系数降低约10.2个百分点。
AI.research_question: 货币政策紧缩是否与石油价格冲击对国内通胀的更低传导效应相关？如果是，这种效应发生在什么时间跨度？
AI.motivation: 摩洛哥自2015年SAMIR炼油厂关闭后完全依赖进口成品油，2020-2022年布伦特原油价格三倍上涨导致该国通胀达30年最高水平（2023年2月CPI同比10.1%），央行随之大幅加息（从1.50%升至3.00%）。这一背景为检验货币紧缩是否降低油价-通胀传导提供了独特的研究机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Tenreyro and Thwaites (2016)关于状态依赖的货币政策传导理论，即货币政策的有效性取决于经济状态（紧缩vs宽松），不同状态下油价冲击向通胀的传导强度存在差异。
AI.method: 采用状态依赖的局部投影法（State-dependent Local Projections, Jordà, 2005），使用2020年1月至2025年6月的月度数据，区分紧缩货币体制（2022年9月-2024年6月）和宽松体制（其余样本期）。通过交互项系数γh估计两种体制下油价冲击传导效应的差异，并进行了五种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）紧缩体制交互系数在13个时间跨度中有12个为负值，在h=8个月时达到-10.2个百分点；（2）宽松体制下，布伦特油价上涨100%在2-3个月后使CPI同比上升1.6-2.0个百分点，与国际基准水平相当；（3）联合检验显著拒绝γh=0的零假设（符号检验p<0.001；Wald χ²=25.8, p=0.018）；（4）机制分析表明效应集中在能源和交通CPI子成分，而非进口边界环节。
AI.theory_contributions: 为状态依赖的货币政策传导理论提供了新兴市场国家的实证证据，验证了Tenreyro and Thwaites (2016)的理论在摩洛哥这一小型开放经济中的适用性，丰富了关于货币政策体制影响外部冲击传导机制的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为摩洛哥及类似依赖进口能源的新兴经济体央行提供了政策启示：积极的货币紧缩政策能够有效削弱国际油价冲击对国内通胀的传导；但需注意紧缩期间同时实施的财政补偿政策可能产生混杂效应，政策制定者应综合考虑货币与财政政策的协同作用。

title: China's Dual Economy: When Strategic Ambition Hollows Out the Foundation
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: China's Dual Economy: When Strategic Ambition Hollows Out the Foundation
detail.abstract: China's dual economy-one side producing world-class technology and exports, the other marked by stagnant household incomes and suppressed consumptionis not a transitional imbalance awaiting self-correction. It is a structural design, engineered to serve China's overriding objective of winning the strategic competition with the United States and establishing global hegemony. The model relies on financially repressed households to fund state-directed investment in high-end manufacturing and technological self-reliance, with a closed capital account ensuring cheap domestic savings remain captive. Yet the model is generating deepening cracks. Corporate involution-intensifying competition without profitability gains-is destroying the margins of even China's best companies. Wage stagnation is hollowing out domestic demand. The AI revolution, rather than resolving these contradictions, risks accelerating labour displacement at the worst possible moment. The rapid piling-up of debt since 2008 constrains fiscal policy tools, which could otherwise have mitigated the slowdown. Protectionism is on the rise, opening a big question market to China's currently buoyant exports. Without structural reform-which Beijing shows no appetite to undertake-the dual economy's internal contradictions will continue to compound.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中国二元经济结构的本质——并非暂时的失衡，而是为赢得对美战略竞争、建立全球霸权而刻意设计的制度安排。该模式依赖金融压抑的 households 为高端制造和科技自主提供资金，但正面临企业内卷、工资停滞、AI加剧劳动力替代、债务高企和贸易保护主义等多重危机，且北京无意进行结构性改革。
AI.research_question: 中国二元经济结构（出口导向型高端产业 vs. 内需不足的国内经济）是过渡性失衡还是系统性设计？其内在矛盾如何演变？
AI.motivation: 解释中国二元经济看似矛盾的现象——一边是世界级科技出口，一边是 household 收入停滞与消费萎靡——并揭示其背后的战略逻辑及未来风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二元经济理论、金融压抑理论、国家资本主义/战略竞争框架、内卷化理论
AI.method: 基于宏观经济学分析框架的政策与结构性分析
AI.findings: 1. 二元经济是服务于对美战略竞争的人为设计，非自然失衡；2. 金融压抑（封闭资本账户、低利率）迫使居民储蓄补贴国家投资；3. 企业内卷加剧（竞争激烈但利润微薄）、工资停滞抑制内需；4. 人工智能革命可能加速劳动力替代；5. 2008年以来债务堆积限制了财政应对空间；6. 保护主义上升威胁出口；7. 北京缺乏结构性改革意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 将中国二元经济重新定义为"战略设计"而非"过渡失衡"，为理解中国政经体制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示投资者、政策制定者和企业关注中国经济增长模式的系统性风险，包括内需萎缩、企业利润恶化、债务约束及地缘政治冲击。

title: Fair Value and Development Risk: Valuing Real Estate Assets Under Development

detail.title: Fair Value and Development Risk: Valuing Real Estate Assets Under Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or animals. Ethical approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract:
Valuing real estate assets under development remains problematic because fair value requires a current exit price, while development assets are defined by incomplete construction, unresolved risk, and timing flexibility. Existing approaches do not integrate these elements coherently. Residual methods leave entrepreneurial return implicit and unstable, cost-progress methods conflate valuation with accounting recognition, and real-options analyses are typically applied outside the fair-value estimate. This creates systematic inconsistency in interim development-stage valuations.
This paper addresses that gap by developing Development Option Valuation (DEVO), a framework that decomposes development stage value into as-stabilised value, remaining cost, and an explicit stage-contingent entrepreneurial incentive, with a further component for economically relevant timing flexibility. DEVO embeds risk transformation and timing choice directly within the valuation estimate rather than treating them residually or externally. The framework is evaluated in a valuation-path simulation of 5,000 projects across four development stages and fifteen scenario conditions. DEVO produces the lowest mean absolute error in fourteen scenarios and remains close to the best-performing alternative in an adversarial case. The paper contributes a more coherent framework for development-stage fair-value measurement and comparative evidence on its performance under stressed conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEVO框架，将开发中房地产资产的价值分解为稳定状态价值、剩余成本、阶段性创业激励和时机灵活性四个部分，解决了公允价值计量中开发阶段资产估值不一致的问题。通过5000个项目模拟，DEVO在14种情景下误差最低。
AI.research_question: 如何为开发中的房地产资产建立一套内在一致的公允价值计量框架？
AI.motivation: 现有方法（剩余法、成本进度法、实物期权分析）无法将未完工状态、未解决风险和时机灵活性等因素整合到公允价值估值中，导致开发阶段中期估值存在系统性的不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开发期权估值（DEVO）框架，将开发阶段价值分解为稳定状态价值、剩余成本、阶段性创业激励和时机灵活性四个组成部分，并将风险转化和时机选择直接嵌入估值估计中。
AI.method: 构建DEVO估值框架，并通过5000个项目的估值路径模拟，涵盖四个开发阶段和十五种情景条件，比较DEVO与传统方法的平均绝对误差。
AI.findings: DEVO在15种情景中的14种产生最低的平均绝对误差；在对抗性情景中，其表现接近最佳替代方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个更内在一致的开发阶段公允价值计量框架，将创业激励和时机灵活性明确纳入估值，而非作为残差或外部因素处理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产估值实务提供了可操作的DEVO框架，并在压力条件下提供了其与传统方法的比较表现证据，有助于提高开发阶段资产估值的准确性和一致性。

title: Valuation Frequency in Direct Real Estate: When More Frequent Is Not More Informative

detail.title: Valuation Frequency in Direct Real Estate: When More Frequent Is Not More Informative

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that there was no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper examines when more frequent valuation in direct real estate adds information and when it merely adds numbers. It compares daily, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual valuation cycles and argues that valuation frequency should be judged by informational arrival rather than administrative cadence. In markets characterised by infrequent transactions, appraisal lag and partial adjustment, publishing valuations more often may increase apparent timeliness while leaving informational content largely unchanged (Geltner, 1991; Geltner, 1993; Clayton, et al., 2001; Cho, et al., 2014). The paper develops an empirical framework around four core hypotheses for comparing alternative valuation paths constructed from the same information set and supplements that framework with a stylised Monte Carlo simulation designed to isolate the mechanism linking latent economic value, formal appraisal value and interim dealing value. The simulation is not presented as a substitute for observed institutional data, but as a necessary way to test how alternative valuation frequencies behave when the underlying informational environment is held constant. The results suggest that monthly valuation may offer the more balanced improvement in the baseline specification, while daily valuation can reduce average error yet still function mainly as a smoothed interpolation process rather than as daily price discovery. The findings also indicate that more frequent dealing values can remain materially dependent on slower appraisal anchors and can still transmit investor-transfer risk when used operationally. A related conditional extension, developed in the empirical design, is that the value of higher frequency should depend on the richness of interim information and the liquidity characteristics of the underlying portfolio. The implications are most acute in open-ended and semi-liquid structures, where frequent dealing terms may rely on stale or smoothed net asset values and thereby contribute to dilution risk, liquidity illusion and fragility (FSB, 2023; IOSCO, 2023; Couts, 2025). The paper concludes that valuation frequency, dealing design, governance and disclosure should be aligned more explicitly than current practice often allows.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了直接房地产估值频率增加何时能带来额外信息，何时只是增加数字噪声。通过比较不同估值周期，发现估值频率应基于信息到达速度而非行政节奏。月度估值提供了较平衡的改进，而日度估值虽降低误差但主要起平滑插值作用，并非真正的价格发现。
AI.research_question: 在直接房地产市场中，更频繁的估值何时能提供增量信息，何时仅增加数字噪声？估值频率、交易设计、治理与披露应如何协同？
AI.motivation: 直接房地产市场交易稀疏、存在评估滞后和部分调整现象，导致估值频率增加可能表面上提升时效性，但信息含量并未实质提升。现有研究（Geltner, 1991等）对此问题有所触及，但缺乏系统性的实证框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息到达速度理论、评估滞后与部分调整理论、价格发现与平滑插值理论、稀释风险与流动性幻觉理论。
AI.method: 构建四核心假设的实证框架，比较同一信息集下不同估值路径；辅以蒙特卡洛模拟，在信息环境恒定条件下隔离潜在经济价值、正式评估价值与临时交易价值之间的传导机制。
AI.findings: 月度估值在基准设定中提供较平衡的改进；日度估值虽降低平均误差，但主要起平滑插值作用而非日度价格发现；频繁交易价值仍显著依赖较慢的评估锚点，操作中可能传递投资者转移风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出估值频率应基于信息到达速度而非行政节奏的判断标准；揭示了高频估值在房地产市场中本质上是平滑插值而非价格发现；建立了估值频率、交易设计与信息环境三者关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对开放式和半流动性结构提出警示：频繁交易条款可能依赖陈旧或平滑的净资产价值，导致稀释风险、流动性幻觉和脆弱性；建议估值频率、交易设计、治理与披露应更明确地相互协调。

title: Liability Structure and Monetary Transmission: Evidence from Life Insurers
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and UNSW Australia Business School, School of Economics

detail.title: Liability Structure and Monetary Transmission: Evidence from Life Insurers
detail.abstract: Monetary tightening reaches retail and institutional liability holders unevenly when channels reprice at different speeds. We study this in life insurance, where annuities and funding agreement-backed notes are backed by the same general account assets and treated pari passu in insolvency. A model of liability pricing under imperfect hedging produces two opposite-signed cross-sectional predictions on the retail--institutional funding wedge. Insurers with more opaque assets open narrower wedges; those with larger pre-period asset-liability margins open wider ones. In a 2020--2025 panel covering one-third of industry general account assets, matching retail annuity rates within insurer to yields and CDS on the same institutional notes, the wedge averages 100 basis points and widens by 60 basis points per standard-deviation compression in the term structure, confirming both predictions. Intermediaries passing more tightening to retail holders are also most exposed to insolvency risk in severe compression, so the distributional channel of monetary tightening and financial-stability risk share the same balance-sheet origin.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了货币紧缩如何通过保险公司不对称地传导至零售（年金）和机构（FABN）负债持有人，发现零售-机构融资利差平均为100个基点，并随着期限结构压缩而扩大；资产透明度低和前期资产负债利差大的保险公司，利差更窄或更宽，且传导更多紧缩的机构在严重压缩时面临更高破产风险。
AI.research_question: 货币紧缩如何不均匀地传导至零售和机构负债持有人？具体地，在寿险行业中，零售年金与机构融资协议支持票据（FABN）之间的融资利差如何形成，以及哪些资产负债表特征决定了这一利差？
AI.motivation: 现实中不同负债渠道重新定价速度不同，导致货币紧缩对各类负债持有人的影响存在差异。这一分布效应对于理解货币政策传导和金融稳定具有重要含义，但此前研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个在不完美对冲条件下负债定价的理论模型，提出了两个方向相反的横截面预测：资产透明度越低的保险公司，零售-机构利差越窄；前期资产负债利差越大的保险公司，利差越宽。
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年覆盖全行业三分之一总账户资产的保险公司面板数据，将保险公司内部的零售年金利率与同一机构发行的FABN收益率和CDS进行匹配，实证检验理论预测。
AI.findings: 零售-机构融资利差平均为100个基点；期限结构每压缩一个标准差，利差扩大60个基点。资产透明度低和前期资产负债利差大的保险公司，分别表现出更窄和更宽的利差。将更多货币紧缩传导给零售持有人的机构，在严重期限结构压缩时面临更高的破产风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上解释了为什么货币紧缩对不同负债持有人产生不对称影响，并基于资产负债表特征（资产透明度、前期资产负债利差）提出了可检验的横截面预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了货币紧缩的分布性渠道与金融稳定风险共享同一资产负债表根源，提示监管者关注利差扩大背后的破产风险，并为理解货币政策通过非银行金融机构的传导机制提供了新视角。

AI.tldr: 叙利亚在经历十余年冲突后进入关键投资阶段，面临约2160亿美元的重建需求（其中1080亿为直接物质损失），制裁缓解与国际参与为从应急恢复转向生产性资本形成创造了窗口期。
AI.research_question: 叙利亚如何在冲突后重建中抓住制裁缓解和国际参与的窗口期，从应急恢复转向生产性资本形成？
AI.motivation: 叙利亚战后重建需求巨大（约2160亿美元），但制裁缓解和国际重新参与创造了有限的战略窗口期，需要分析如何利用这一机会促进生产性投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突后重建经济学、资本形成理论、制度经济学
AI.method: 基于世界银行等国际机构的重建成本估算数据，结合制裁缓解与区域投资承诺的制度背景分析
AI.findings: 叙利亚重建需求约2160亿美元，其中直接物质损失约1080亿美元；制裁缓解和国际机构重新参与为向生产性资本形成转型提供了机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了冲突后国家从人道主义应急向生产性投资转型的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为叙利亚重建政策制定者以及国际援助机构在制裁缓解背景下的投资策略提供参考

title: The NGT-1 Patent Trap: How Europe Freed Gene-Edited Crops but Enclosed Their Genetics -and What International Financial Institutions Should Do Before the Mistake Spreads

detail.title: The NGT-1 Patent Trap: How Europe Freed Gene-Edited Crops but Enclosed Their Genetics -and What International Financial Institutions Should Do Before the Mistake Spreads

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
We reframe NGT-1 varieties as agronomic accelerators rather than a new technology category. NGTbred varieties reach the same biological outcomes as conventional breeding, but faster — chiefly by compressing the development and selection phase. Because field validation and official registration are the same for every method, the realistic saving to a finished, registered variety is on the order of onethird to one-half of the total cycle (roughly 10–14 years down to 6–9 years), not the larger figure sometimes claimed. The gain is real but moderate — which makes enclosing it in permanent utility patents a disproportionate bargain. 
The EU’s NGT-1 framework separates scientific deregulation from patent enforcement. It removes the Breeder’s Exemption — in Czech, šlechtitelská výjimka — for edited lines, and lets companies claim utility patents over native genetic sequences. The EU has now made the same kind of mistake twice. First, two decades of regulatory delay cost an estimated €40–65 billion in lost agricultural value (Wesseler & Purnhagen, 2021). Now the patent trap risks a second loss — this time by transferring the gains of reform to a few patent holders instead of the many producers who do the work.
 A hidden legal trap follows. The final rules drop GMO-style food labelling, but require a public registry that lists each NGT-1 variety together with the laboratory method to detect its patented genes. With no protective law in place, this lets patent holders test a small breeder’s fields, find a patented gene that arrived by accidental cross-pollination, and sue — exactly the situation in the Canadian Schmeiser case.
 A stylised genetic-gain model suggests Ukraine could close the EU–Ukraine cereal yield gap within a decade — if and only if it does not replicate the EU’s patent-locked architecture. The same logic applies to ECA reconstruction and to North Africa. 
Multinational rent-seeking is rational private behaviour. The institutional duty to internalise its externalities is a public-policy responsibility (Pigou, 1920; Tirole, 1988; Stiglitz, 2008). 
This patent trap creates a structural "Public Budgetary Exposure." If seed costs rise due to patent-gated enclosure, the CAP will inevitably be forced to increase support payments to prevent farm bankruptcies —a direct, avoidable drain on EU fiscal resources.
 We propose a Parallel Feasibility Pathway: Sovereign Patent Clearinghouses, statutory Legal Safe Harbours, and an Epistemic Parity Co-efficient (Ep ≥ 0.50) mandating field-level scientific and appliedeconomic representation across drafting, advisory, and diplomatic positions.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义NGT-1品种为"农艺加速器"而非新技术类别，指出其实际节约时间约为总周期的1/3至1/2（10-14年缩减至6-9年），但欧盟将其纳入永久性实用专利构成不成比例的"专利陷阱"，可能重蹈监管延误导致400-650亿欧元损失的覆辙，并提出平行可行性路径作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 欧盟NGT-1监管框架中的专利制度如何影响农业创新、小农生计和公共财政，以及如何避免"专利陷阱"？
AI.motivation: 欧盟对NGT-1品种的监管改革虽然在科学上放宽了准入，但专利制度却可能使改革成果被少数专利持有者攫取，重演历史上监管延误造成的巨大经济损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 庇古外部性理论（Pigou, 1920）、产业组织理论（Tirole, 1988）、信息不对称与公共政策理论（Stiglitz, 2008），以及遗传增益模型。
AI.method: 法律与政策分析、案例比较（加拿大Schmeiser案）、遗传增益模型模拟（乌克兰与欧盟谷物产量差距）、制度经济学分析。
AI.findings: （1）NGT-1实际节约时间仅为1/3至1/2，而非夸大数字；（2）欧盟专利制度取消了育种者豁免，允许对天然基因序列申请实用专利，构成"专利陷阱"；（3）公开登记制度使小育种者面临被起诉风险；（4）若乌克兰复制欧盟专利架构，将无法弥合产量差距；（5）专利陷阱形成"公共预算敞口"，可能迫使CAP增加补贴。
AI.theory_contributions: 将庇古外部性理论应用于现代农业生物技术专利治理，提出"公共预算敞口"新概念，建立了知识产权制度与财政政策之间的理论联动。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出平行可行性路径：主权专利清算所、法定安全港、认知平价系数（Ep≥0.50），为欧盟及发展中国家避免专利陷阱提供可操作的政策建议。

title: Digital Payments and the Inflation Cost of Formalization: Evidence from Brazil's PIX

detail.title: Digital Payments and the Inflation Cost of Formalization: Evidence from Brazil's PIX

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose. No party had the right to review the paper prior to its circulation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available, aggregate data from official sources (Central Bank of Brazil, IBGE, BCB Focus, IPEA, and FRED) and involves no human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Brazil's PIX changed not the quantity of cash but its function. Using the correct currency series, Brazil's currency-to-M2 ratio was near 7% before PIX, comparable to Mexico's, not the 1.4% a mismeasured series implied. PIX did not eliminate this stock; it collapsed cash's transactional velocity: withdrawals fell about 40% while PIX rose to R$35 trillion a year. I propose a Cash-in-Motion Channel : when informal exchange leaves cash, shocks transmit more fully to prices. Currency-demand and suggestive Phillips evidence are consistent with the mechanism; the macro magnitude remains confounded.

AI.tldr: 巴西PIX支付系统并未减少现金总量，而是改变了现金的功能——大幅降低了现金的交易流通速度。作者提出"现金流动渠道"机制：当非正规交易中的现金退出使用时，经济冲击会更完全地传导至价格。
AI.research_question: 巴西即时支付系统PIX如何影响现金的功能、货币流通速度以及宏观经济中的价格传导机制？
AI.motivation: 纠正巴西货币度量误差（实际现金/M2比率约为7%而非1.4%），并解释PIX对现金功能而非数量的结构性改变，以及这一变化对宏观经济（尤其是价格传导）的意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出"现金流动渠道"（Cash-in-Motion Channel）：当非正式经济中现金交易被数字支付替代后，经济冲击（如需求或供给冲击）会更充分、更迅速地传导至价格水平。
AI.method: 使用正确的货币序列数据（而非存在测量误差的数据）；现金需求模型估计；菲利普斯曲线回归（Phillips Curve evidence）进行机制检验。
AI.findings: （1）巴西现金/M2比率实际约为7%（而非此前文献声称的1.4%），与墨西哥水平相当；（2）PIX并未减少现金存量，但使现金的交易流通速度骤降：现金提取量下降约40%，而PIX交易量达到每年35万亿雷亚尔；（3）现金需求模型和菲利普斯曲线证据与"现金流动渠道"机制一致，但宏观量级仍待识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"现金流动渠道"这一新机制，将支付系统创新与宏观经济价格传导联系起来，丰富了对货币职能分离（价值储藏 vs. 交易媒介）如何影响宏观经济的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 纠正了巴西货币度量的系统性误差；提示政策制定者：数字支付系统（如PIX）可能通过改变现金的流通速度而非现金总量来影响货币政策的传导效率，尤其是对非正规经济部门的价格压力。

title: Exit Gradients, Intelligence Density, and the Tech-Wealth Spiral

detail.title: Exit Gradients, Intelligence Density, and the Tech-Wealth Spiral

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no external funding and was completed independently by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing financial interests, institutional conflicts, or other conflicts of interest relevant to this manuscript

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a unified political-economy model of why some jurisdictions repeatedly attract globally mobile high-skill and high-income contributors while others lose them. The core mechanism runs from gradient-driven elite mobility to intelligence density, from intelligence density to lower organizational costs of acquiring high-end cognition ('price compression'), from lower cognitive-organization costs to faster technical advance, and from technical advance to wealth amplification and renewed destination attractiveness. The same framework also explains origin-side tax-base fragility when mobile contributors are heavily concentrated in the revenue structure, and destination-side social carrying-capacity limits when successful concentration generates housing inflation, infrastructure strain, and backlash politics. The manuscript treats its equations as directional schemata rather than empirically estimated functions. It also states explicit falsification conditions: the mechanism is weakened if dense nodes do not exhibit lower organizational costs, if elite exit fails to generate disproportionate fiscal or organizational strain where contributor concentration is high, or if successful destination nodes do not become more attractive to subsequent mobile cohorts. The argument is developed as a long-form SSRN preprint rather than a compressed journal article.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的政治经济学模型，解释为何一些地区能持续吸引全球高技能高收入流动人才，而另一些地区则流失人才。核心机制是：精英梯度驱动流动→智力密度→降低高端认知组织成本（价格压缩）→加速技术进步→财富放大与目的地吸引力提升。同时解释了来源地税基脆弱性与目的地的社会承载上限问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些司法管辖区能反复吸引全球流动的高技能、高收入人群，而另一些却会失去他们？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多分别讨论人才流动、税收竞争或技术创新，缺乏一个统一框架来解释人才集聚与流失的双向动态及其政治经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学模型，核心链条：梯度驱动精英流动→智力密度→认知组织成本压缩（价格压缩）→技术进步加速→财富放大→目的地吸引力提升；同时纳入来源地税基脆弱性与目的地社会承载极限。
AI.method: 理论推导与形式化建模，方程作为方向性图式（directional schemata）而非经验估计函数；明确列出可证伪条件。
AI.findings: （1）精英流动通过智力密度降低认知组织成本，推动技术进步与财富放大；（2）高技能人才高度集中的来源地面临税基脆弱性；（3）成功目的地可能因房价通胀、基础设施压力和反弹政治而达到社会承载上限。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出统一的政治经济学框架，整合人才流动、技术变迁与财政可持续性；（2）明确给出可证伪条件，增强了理论的可检验性；（3）将"价格压缩"概念引入人才集聚与创新经济学分析。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者理解人才流失与集聚的循环机制提供分析工具；（2）警示来源地税基过度依赖高流动性精英的风险；（3）提醒目的地需管理社会承载极限，避免基础设施超载与政治反弹。

title: Attention-guided multi-modal learning for high-throughput screening of environmental chemicals associated with breast cancer risk
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hangzhou Normal University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - State Key Laboratory of Environmental Chemistry and Ecotoxicology

detail.title: Attention-guided multi-modal learning for high-throughput screening of environmental chemicals associated with breast cancer risk
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of chemical production and use has increased human exposure to environmental endocrine disruptors, many of which are implicated in breast cancer related biological pathways. This trend creates an urgent need for scalable and mechanism informed screening tools that can identify chemicals of potential concern before extensive animal testing or widespread exposure occurs. Conventional predictive models built solely on molecular structures do not capture the biological complexity of chemical induced carcinogenesis, which limits both predictive robustness and toxicological interpretability. Here, we introduce BCPredictor, a multi-modal deep learning framework that integrates a graph attention network (GAT) and a fully connected neural network (FCNN) to screen chemicals associated with breast cancer risk. The model synergistically fuses molecular graph representations, structural descriptors, breast cancer relevant bioassay activity profiles, and estrogen receptor/progesterone receptor interaction scores within a unified architecture. Trained on a curated set of 897 compounds, BCPredictor achieves an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.928 and a recall of 0.892, with strong generalizability on independent external validation sets. The incorporation of biologically and mechanistically anchored features improves AUC by up to 7.8%. BCPredictor has been deployed as a cloud-based screening platform (http://www.ai4environ.cn/bcpredictor) that enables high throughput and confidence aware chemical prioritization. This study provides a mechanism informed computational toxicology framework for environmental health risk assessment, supports next generation new approach methodologies (NAMs), and helps prioritize chemicals that warrant further experimental or regulatory evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BCPredictor，一种多模态深度学习框架，通过整合分子图表示、结构描述符、生物测定活性谱和激素受体交互评分，用于筛查与乳腺癌风险相关的化学物质，在897种化合物上训练达到0.928 AUC，并部署为云端筛选平台。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种可扩展且具有机制信息的计算工具，用于在动物实验或大规模暴露发生之前，筛查与乳腺癌风险相关的环境化学物质？
AI.motivation: 化学品种类和使用的快速扩张增加了人类暴露于环境内分泌干扰物的风险，其中许多与乳腺癌相关生物通路有关。传统的仅基于分子结构的预测模型无法捕捉化学诱导癌变的生物复杂性，限制了预测稳健性和毒理学可解释性，因此迫切需要一种机制信息驱动的规模化筛选工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态深度学习框架（图注意力网络GAT + 全连接神经网络FCNN）；化学结构与生物活性特征融合；内分泌干扰机制（雌激素受体/孕激素受体交互）；新方法论（NAMs）。
AI.method: 构建BCPredictor多模态深度学习模型，融合四种特征模态：分子图表示（GAT处理）、结构描述符、乳腺癌相关生物测定活性谱、ER/PR交互评分。使用897种化合物进行训练，并在独立外部验证集上评估泛化能力。
AI.findings: BCPredictor在897种化合物上训练达到AUC 0.928和召回率0.892，在独立外部验证集上表现出强泛化能力。纳入生物和机制锚定特征使AUC提升最高达7.8%。模型已部署为云端筛选平台。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种机制信息驱动的计算毒理学框架，将化学结构信息与生物学活性数据多模态融合，突破了传统仅依赖分子结构的预测范式，为化学诱导乳腺癌风险筛查提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了云端可访问的高通量筛选平台（http://www.ai4environ.cn/bcpredictor），支持信心感知的化学物质优先级排序；助力下一代新方法论（NAMs）的发展；帮助监管和实验机构优先评估那些需要进一步检测的化学物质，降低动物实验依赖和公众健康风险。

title: Point Forecasts, Density Signals, and the Limits of Parsimony: Inflation Prediction Across Regimes in Colombia

detail.title: Point Forecasts, Density Signals, and the Limits of Parsimony: Inflation Prediction Across Regimes in Colombia
detail.abstract: Why do simple autoregressive models consistently outperform multivariate specifications in inflation forecasting? This paper argues that the "inflation forecasting puzzle" is substantially a measurement puzzle. Using Colombia's 2015–2026 inflation cycle—spanning stable targeting, COVID-19, a 13.3% surge, and disinflation—I show that the near-unit-root persistence of year-over-year inflation (ρ = 0.99) reflects an eleven-month mechanical overlap that artificially advantages univariate specifications. When evaluated on month-over-month inflation, which removes this overlap, approximately 60% of the AR's apparent superiority disappears (rRMSFE improves from 0.758 to only 0.896). This measurement channel has been overlooked in the forecasting literature. Once recognized, a second finding emerges: the models that underperform on point accuracy provide superior density calibration. The BVAR achieves 88% empirical coverage at h = 1, and quantile regression bands captured the December 2022 peak of 13.3% in real time—a tail-risk signal no point forecast delivered. A Giacomini-Rossi fluctuation test formally rejects constant relative predictive ability (sup |DM| = 4.04, p < 0.01), while Dynamic Model Averaging weights provide an informative real-time signal of changing inflation dynamics: the AR absorbs 54% of weight during supply-driven surges as multivariate transmission mechanisms become disrupted. These findings imply that central banks require dual forecasting architectures—but more fundamentally, that the standard evaluation framework conflates measurement persistence with economic persistence.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了通胀预测"谜题"本质上是测量问题：年同比通胀率因11个月机械重叠而呈现近单位根过程，人为导致单变量模型表现更优。改用月环比通胀后，AR模型优势消失约60%。同时，表现较差的点预测模型在密度校准上更优，BVAR可实现88%经验覆盖，分位数回归实时捕捉到13.3%通胀峰值。
AI.research_question: 为什么简单自回归模型在通胀预测中始终优于多变量模型？这一"通胀预测谜题"的本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统文献将"通胀预测谜题"视为一个未解之谜，作者认为该谜题实质上是一个被忽视的测量问题。通过利用哥伦比亚2015–2026年完整通胀周期（包括稳定目标制、COVID-19、13.3%通胀飙升和反通胀过程），作者试图重新审视这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 测量偏差理论：年同比通胀率的11个月机械重叠导致近单位根过程（ρ=0.99），人为优势化单变量模型；2) 预测评估框架批判：标准评估体系混淆了测量持久性与经济持久性；3) 密度预测理论：点预测准确性不代表密度校准质量。
AI.method: 1) 比较年同比与月环比通胀预测表现；2) Giacomini-Rossi波动检验检验常数相对预测能力；3) 动态模型平均（DMA）权重分析；4) 分位数回归；5) BVAR密度预测覆盖率评估。
AI.findings: 1) 年同比通胀的ρ=0.99源自11个月机械重叠；2) 改用月环比通胀后，AR模型约60%优势消失（rRMSFE从0.758降至0.896）；3) BVAR在h=1时实现88%经验覆盖率；4) 分位数回归实时捕捉到2022年12月13.3%通胀峰值；5) 波动检验拒绝常数相对预测能力（sup|DM|=4.04, p<0.01）；6) DMA显示供给冲击期间AR模型权重升至54%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发现并证明"通胀预测谜题"本质是测量问题，而非真正的经济理论悖论；2) 揭示标准预测评估框架混淆了测量持久性与经济持久性，为预测方法论提供重要修正；3) 提出点预测与密度预测的双轨评估标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议央行采用双轨预测架构（点预测+密度预测/分位数预测）；2) 为实际通胀预测中的模型选择提供指导：不同通胀阶段应动态调整模型权重；3) 为通胀尾部风险预警提供实时方法（分位数回归捕捉峰值）；4) 强调通胀测量指标选择对预测评估的实质性影响。

title: Awareness to Action: Effects of Providing Information and Enabling Access to Clean Water
affiliations: Jawaharlal Nehru University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Calcutta - Department of Economics

detail.title: Awareness to Action: Effects of Providing Information and Enabling Access to Clean Water
detail.abstract: Households in low-income settings often face two barriers to adopting safer environmental technologies: incomplete information about local hazards and high administrative costs of accessing public services. We study these frictions in rural India, where groundwater is heavily contaminated with arsenic, using a cluster randomized controlled trial conducted prior to the rollout of piped water under a large scale government program. Households received either arsenic-specific risk information or the same information plus assistance with completing the paperwork for a piped connection. Information alone did not raise demand, pointing to administrative barriers rather than information gaps as the binding constraint. The combined intervention increased short-run demand by 128 percent and connection rates by 40 percent two years later, with the largest effects among households previously disappointed by government water programs - suggesting that helping households navigate paperwork raises uptake partly by rebuilding trust in government commitment to service delivery. Treated households also extended breastfeeding by nearly two months and showed improvements in maternal hemoglobin. These findings suggest that where infrastructure rollout is gradual, pairing it with early interventions that reduce administrative barriers and rebuild trust can generate sustained behavioral change

AI.tldr: 在印度农村砷污染地区，仅提供风险信息无法提高家庭接入管网的意愿，但信息+文书协助干预使短期需求增长128%、两年后接网率提高40%，且效果在曾对政府项目失望的群体中最大，表明降低行政壁垒和重建信任是促进技术采纳的关键。
AI.research_question: 在低收入环境中，信息不完善和高行政成本如何影响家庭采用更安全的环境技术？
AI.motivation: 印度农村地下水砷污染严重，政府正大规模推行管网供水，但家庭采纳率低，需要对信息障碍和行政障碍这两个潜在摩擦进行因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、行政负担理论、信任与政府承诺理论
AI.method: 集群随机对照试验，在政府管网项目推广前实施，设仅信息组和信息+文书协助组，追踪短期和两年后效果。
AI.findings: (1) 仅提供信息不提升需求，行政壁垒是主要约束；(2) 信息+文书协助使短期需求增长128%，两年后接入率提高40%；(3) 效果在曾被政府供水项目"辜负"的群体中最大；(4) 干预还延长母乳喂养近两个月，改善母亲血红蛋白水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了信息摩擦与行政摩擦在技术采纳中的相对重要性，揭示了"重建信任"作为行政减负促进采纳的心理机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入国家的基础设施推广提供了可操作的政策路径：在管网逐步铺设的同时，配以降低行政壁垒和重建信任的早期干预，能产生持续的行为改变。

title: Nelson-Siegel Autoencoders for Global Yield Curve Forecasting
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam,  and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE)

detail.title: Nelson-Siegel Autoencoders for Global Yield Curve Forecasting
detail.abstract: We study global yield curve dynamics using an economics-informed autoencoder framework that captures the hierarchical structure of international bond markets. We propose a Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder anchored in the Nelson-Siegel basis that decomposes a panel of yield curves into global and country-specific components. For forecasting, we introduce a Dynamic Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder that jointly learns latent factors and their linear time-series dynamics. Using monthly government bond yields for the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Japan from 1995 to 2023, we show that global factors explain a large and time-varying share of yield variation. Global models deliver robust out-of-sample forecasting gains for the United States and the United Kingdom, particularly during periods of heightened global uncertainty. Forecasting improvements increase with the horizon, consistent with global factors being especially informative for longer-term risk compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于经济学信息的自编码器框架（Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder），用于分解全球收益率曲线的层次结构，并引入动态版本（Dynamic Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder）进行预测，发现全球因子在不确定时期对美国、英国等国的收益率预测有显著提升。
AI.research_question: 如何利用全局-国家层次结构分解全球收益率曲线，并提升预测表现？
AI.motivation: 现有收益率曲线模型多集中于单国分析，忽视了全球债券市场间的层次关联性；同时，传统的Nelson-Siegel模型在跨国产出中缺乏对全局因子的系统提取与动态建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: Nelson-Siegel因子模型、自编码器（Autoencoder）、层次结构分解、动态潜在因子时间序列模型。
AI.method: 提出Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder（静态分解）和Dynamic Global Nelson-Siegel Autoencoder（动态预测），对美国、德国、英国、日本1995-2023年月度政府债券收益率进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 全球因子解释了收益率变动的较大且时变的比例；全球模型在美、英两国样本外预测中表现稳健，尤其在高度全球不确定性时期；预测改进随预测期限延长而增加，表明全局因子对长期风险补偿尤其具有信息含量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Nelson-Siegel模型拓展至多国层次结构框架，结合深度学习自编码器实现全局与国别因子的联合提取，为国际金融中的收益率曲线建模提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和央行提供了更准确的跨国收益率预测工具，尤其在全球危机时期有助于改进风险评估与资产定价。

title: TablEye: Seeing small Tables through the Lens of Images
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: TablEye: Seeing small Tables through the Lens of Images
detail.abstract: Few-shot tabular learning is increasingly important: labeled tables are costly and rare in high-stakes domains such as medical diagnosis, yet the field lags far behind few-shot learning in vision and language. The gap persists because tabular data lacks the shared structure that lets models transfer prior knowledge across datasets, and existing remedies impose their own constraints—semi-few-shot methods need a large unlabeled pool, while language-model methods require meaningful feature names and billions of parameters. We propose TablEye, which instead transfers prior knowledge from the image domain to tabular data: each row is converted into a tabular image that preserves feature semantics through spatial relations, and few-shot algorithms then reuse prior knowledge learned from natural images. This cross-domain transfer makes the rich prior knowledge of large-scale image data available to tabular tasks without restricting the dataset. Using no unlabeled data and a model up to five orders of magnitude smaller than a large language model (LLM) baseline, TablEye surpasses the LLM-based TabLLM by up to 0.11 AUC in a 4-shot task and the semi-few-shot STUNT by about 3.00% accuracy in a 1-shot setting, while handling high-dimensional tables with uninformative feature names that text-based methods cannot process. These results position cross-domain visual priors as a practical, constraint-free route to data-efficient tabular learning

AI.tldr: TablEye通过将表格数据行转换为保留语义的表格图像，利用图像领域的先验知识实现小样本表格学习，无需无标签数据和大规模语言模型，在性能上超越LLM和半小样本基线方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖无标签数据或大规模语言模型的前提下，实现高效的小样本表格学习？
AI.motivation: 小样本表格学习在医疗诊断等高价值领域至关重要，但表格数据缺乏视觉和语言领域的共享结构，现有方法（半小样本需大量无标签数据、LLM方法需有意义的特征名和数十亿参数）存在诸多限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨域迁移学习：将图像域的先验知识通过"表格图像化"（空间关系保留特征语义）迁移到表格数据的小样本学习中。
AI.method: 将表格每一行转换为表格图像，通过空间关系保留特征语义，再利用已有小样本图像分类算法从自然图像中迁移先验知识。
AI.findings: TablEye在4-shot任务中AUC超越LLM方法TabLLM达0.11，在1-shot任务中准确率超越半小样本方法STUNT约3.00%，模型规模比LLM基线小五个数量级，且能处理文本方法无法处理的高维无信息特征名表格。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出跨域视觉先验作为小样本表格学习的有效替代路径，突破了传统小样本表格学习对共享结构、无标签数据和巨大模型规模的依赖。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种不受数据集限制、无需无标签数据、模型轻量化的实用型小样本表格学习方案，尤其适用于医疗诊断等高价值但数据稀缺的场景。
